<!-- Load Socket.IO client library -->
<script src="/socket.io/socket.io.js"></script>

<script>
  // ==========================================
  // TOP-LEVEL MODAL CONTROLS (ALWAYS AVAILABLE)
  // ==========================================
  function openCartModal() {
    console.log('[DEBUG] openCartModal called');
    const modal = document.getElementById('table-cart-modal');
    if (modal) {
      modal.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
      modal.classList.add('is-open');
    }
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    loadCartDetails();
  }

  function closeCartModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('table-cart-modal');
    if (modal) {
      modal.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
      modal.classList.remove('is-open');
    }
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  function closeCustomizeModal() {
    const customModal = document.getElementById('customize-item-modal');
    if (customModal) {
      customModal.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
      customModal.classList.remove('is-open');
    }
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  function loadCartDetails() {
    const content = document.getElementById('cart-modal-content');
    const totalEl = document.getElementById('cart-modal-total');
    const confirmBtn = document.getElementById('confirm-order-btn');

    if (content) {
      content.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:32px 16px;color:var(--muted);">Loading order details...</div>';
    }

    fetch('/get-tablecart?show=my')
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(data => {
        if (content) {
          content.innerHTML = data.html || '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--muted);padding:24px 0;">No items in order yet.</p>';
        }
        if (totalEl) {
          totalEl.textContent = '$' + (data.total ? Number(data.total).toFixed(2) : '0.00');
        }

        if (confirmBtn) {
          if (!data.unconfirmed_item_count || data.unconfirmed_item_count === 0) {
            confirmBtn.style.display = 'none';
          } else {
            confirmBtn.style.display = 'inline-flex';
            confirmBtn.textContent = 'Send Order to Kitchen (' + data.unconfirmed_item_count + ') 🚀';
          }
        }

        if (content) {
          content.querySelectorAll('.delete-cart-item').forEach(delBtn => {
            delBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
              const delId = delBtn.dataset.itemId;
              fetch('/table-order/delete/' + delId).then(() => {
                loadCartDetails();
                refreshCart();
              });
            });
          });
        }
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        if (content) {
          content.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#be123c;padding:24px 0;">Could not load cart details. Please try again.</p>';
        }
      });
  }

  // ==========================================
  // PAGE INITIALIZATION
  // ==========================================
  const currentTableId = <%= table.id %>;
  const currentRestaurantId = <%= restaurant.id %>;

  // --- 1. REAL-TIME KDS TRACKER ---
  const trackerBox = document.getElementById('live-order-tracker');
  const stepReceived = document.getElementById('step-received');
  const stepCooking = document.getElementById('step-cooking');
  const stepServed = document.getElementById('step-served');
  const trackerSummary = document.getElementById('tracker-summary-text');
  const trackerBadge = document.getElementById('tracker-active-badge');

  function updateTrackerUI(tableStatus, items) {
    if (!trackerBox) return;
    if (!items || items.length === 0) {
      trackerBox.style.display = 'none';
      return;
    }

    const hasConfirmedOrCooking = items.some(i => ['order_food', 'order_drink', 'preparing', 'confirmed'].includes(i.status));
    const allServed = items.every(i => i.status === 'order_delivered');
    const isCooking = items.some(i => i.status === 'preparing');

    if (!hasConfirmedOrCooking && !allServed) {
      trackerBox.style.display = 'none';
      return;
    }

    trackerBox.style.display = 'block';

    [stepReceived, stepCooking, stepServed].forEach(s => {
      if (s) {
        s.style.background = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)';
        s.style.borderColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
      }
    });

    if (allServed) {
      if (stepServed) {
        stepServed.style.background = 'rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.35)';
        stepServed.style.borderColor = '#16a34a';
      }
      if (trackerSummary) trackerSummary.textContent = 'All dishes have been served to Table ' + <%= JSON.stringify(table.table_name) %>;
      if (trackerBadge) {
        trackerBadge.textContent = '✓ Served';
        trackerBadge.style.background = '#16a34a';
      }
    } else if (isCooking || tableStatus === 'preparing') {
      if (stepCooking) {
        stepCooking.style.background = 'rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.35)';
        stepCooking.style.borderColor = '#ea580c';
      }
      if (trackerSummary) trackerSummary.textContent = 'Chefs are currently preparing your dishes in the kitchen';
      if (trackerBadge) {
        trackerBadge.textContent = '🔥 Cooking';
        trackerBadge.style.background = '#ea580c';
      }
    } else {
      if (stepReceived) {
        stepReceived.style.background = 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.35)';
        stepReceived.style.borderColor = '#3b82f6';
      }
      if (trackerSummary) trackerSummary.textContent = 'Order queued and sent to kitchen display';
      if (trackerBadge) {
        trackerBadge.textContent = '📋 Queued';
        trackerBadge.style.background = '#3b82f6';
      }
    }
  }

  function pollOrderStatus() {
    fetch('/get-tablecart?show=my')
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(data => {
        let items = [];
        try {
          items = Object.values(JSON.parse(data.cart || '{}'));
        } catch(e) {}
        updateTrackerUI(data.status, items);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }

  try {
    if (typeof io !== 'undefined') {
      const socket = io();
      socket.emit('join-restaurant', currentRestaurantId);
      socket.on('restaurant-update', () => {
        pollOrderStatus();
        refreshCart();
      });
    }
  } catch(e) {}

  pollOrderStatus();

  // --- 2. QUICK ADD OFFERS ---
  document.querySelectorAll('.quick-add-offer-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const itemId = btn.dataset.itemId;
      const orig = btn.textContent;
      btn.textContent = 'Adding...';
      btn.disabled = true;

      fetch('/add-table-menu', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          table_id: currentTableId,
          items: [{ item_id: itemId, quantity: 1 }],
        }),
      })
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(res => {
          btn.textContent = '✓ Added';
          setTimeout(() => {
            btn.textContent = orig;
            btn.disabled = false;
          }, 800);
          refreshCart();
          pollOrderStatus();
        })
        .catch(() => {
          btn.textContent = orig;
          btn.disabled = false;
        });
    });
  });

  // --- 3. ITEM CUSTOMIZATION MODAL ---
  const customModal = document.getElementById('customize-item-modal');
  const modalDishName = document.getElementById('modal-dish-name');
  const modalDishDesc = document.getElementById('modal-dish-desc');
  const modalVariantsSection = document.getElementById('modal-variants-section');
  const modalVariantsList = document.getElementById('modal-variants-list');
  const modalToppingsSection = document.getElementById('modal-toppings-section');
  const modalToppingsList = document.getElementById('modal-toppings-list');
  const modalNotes = document.getElementById('modal-dish-notes');
  const modalQtyDisplay = document.getElementById('modal-qty-display');
  const modalTotalPrice = document.getElementById('modal-total-price');
  const modalAddToCartBtn = document.getElementById('modal-add-to-cart-btn');

  let currentItem = null;
  let currentQty = 1;

  document.querySelectorAll('.open-customize-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const variants = JSON.parse(btn.dataset.variants || '[]');
      const toppings = JSON.parse(btn.dataset.toppings || '[]');

      currentItem = {
        id: btn.dataset.itemId,
        name: btn.dataset.itemName,
        desc: btn.dataset.itemDesc,
        basePrice: parseFloat(btn.dataset.itemPrice) || 0,
        variants,
        toppings,
      };

      currentQty = 1;
      if (modalQtyDisplay) modalQtyDisplay.textContent = '1';
      if (modalNotes) modalNotes.value = '';
      if (modalDishName) modalDishName.textContent = currentItem.name;
      if (modalDishDesc) modalDishDesc.textContent = currentItem.desc;

      if (variants.length > 0 && modalVariantsSection && modalVariantsList) {
        modalVariantsSection.style.display = 'block';
        modalVariantsList.innerHTML = variants.map((v, i) => `
          <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;">
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;">
              <input type="radio" name="modal_variant" value="${v.id}" data-price="${v.price}" ${i === 0 ? 'checked' : ''} style="margin:0;">
              <span style="font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink);">${v.name}</span>
            </div>
            <strong style="color:var(--brand);font-size:13.5px;">$${parseFloat(v.price).toFixed(2)}</strong>
          </label>
        `).join('');
      } else if (modalVariantsSection) {
        modalVariantsSection.style.display = 'none';
        modalVariantsList.innerHTML = '';
      }

      if (toppings.length > 0 && modalToppingsSection && modalToppingsList) {
        modalToppingsSection.style.display = 'block';
        modalToppingsList.innerHTML = toppings.map(t => `
          <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;">
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;">
              <input type="checkbox" name="modal_topping" value="${t.id}" data-price="${t.price}" style="margin:0;">
              <span style="font-size:13px;color:var(--ink);">${t.name}</span>
            </div>
            <span style="color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;">+$${parseFloat(t.price).toFixed(2)}</span>
          </label>
        `).join('');
      } else if (modalToppingsSection) {
        modalToppingsSection.style.display = 'none';
        modalToppingsList.innerHTML = '';
      }

      if (modalVariantsList) {
        modalVariantsList.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(r => r.addEventListener('change', recalcModalPrice));
      }
      if (modalToppingsList) {
        modalToppingsList.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(c => c.addEventListener('change', recalcModalPrice));
      }

      recalcModalPrice();
      if (customModal) {
        customModal.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
        customModal.classList.add('is-open');
      }
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    });
  });

  function recalcModalPrice() {
    if (!currentItem) return;
    let unitPrice = currentItem.basePrice;

    if (modalVariantsList) {
      const selectedVariant = modalVariantsList.querySelector('input[name="modal_variant"]:checked');
      if (selectedVariant) {
        unitPrice = parseFloat(selectedVariant.dataset.price) || unitPrice;
      }
    }

    if (modalToppingsList) {
      modalToppingsList.querySelectorAll('input[name="modal_topping"]:checked').forEach(t => {
        unitPrice += parseFloat(t.dataset.price) || 0;
      });
    }

    const total = unitPrice * currentQty;
    if (modalTotalPrice) modalTotalPrice.textContent = '$' + total.toFixed(2);
  }

  const qtyPlus = document.getElementById('qty-plus-btn');
  if (qtyPlus) {
    qtyPlus.addEventListener('click', () => {
      currentQty++;
      if (modalQtyDisplay) modalQtyDisplay.textContent = currentQty;
      recalcModalPrice();
    });
  }

  const qtyMinus = document.getElementById('qty-minus-btn');
  if (qtyMinus) {
    qtyMinus.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (currentQty > 1) {
        currentQty--;
        if (modalQtyDisplay) modalQtyDisplay.textContent = currentQty;
        recalcModalPrice();
      }
    });
  }

  if (modalAddToCartBtn) {
    modalAddToCartBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      if (!currentItem) return;
      modalAddToCartBtn.disabled = true;
      modalAddToCartBtn.textContent = 'Adding to Tab...';

      let variantId = null;
      if (modalVariantsList) {
        const selectedVariant = modalVariantsList.querySelector('input[name="modal_variant"]:checked');
        variantId = selectedVariant ? selectedVariant.value : null;
      }

      let selectedToppings = [];
      if (modalToppingsList) {
        selectedToppings = Array.from(modalToppingsList.querySelectorAll('input[name="modal_topping"]:checked')).map(t => parseInt(t.value, 10));
      }
      const comment = modalNotes ? modalNotes.value.trim() : '';

      try {
        const res = await fetch('/add-table-menu', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            table_id: currentTableId,
            items: [{
              item_id: currentItem.id,
              variant_id: variantId,
              quantity: currentQty,
              comment: comment,
              toppings: selectedToppings
            }]
          })
        });
        const data = await res.json();
        modalAddToCartBtn.disabled = false;
        modalAddToCartBtn.textContent = '+ Add to Tab';

        if (res.ok) {
          closeCustomizeModal();
          refreshCart();
          pollOrderStatus();
        } else {
          alert(data.error || 'Could not add item to tab.');
        }
      } catch(err) {
        modalAddToCartBtn.disabled = false;
        modalAddToCartBtn.textContent = '+ Add to Tab';
        alert('Network error while adding to order.');
      }
    });
  }

  // --- 4. CONFIRM ORDER TO KITCHEN ---
  const confirmOrderBtn = document.getElementById('confirm-order-btn');
  if (confirmOrderBtn) {
    confirmOrderBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      confirmOrderBtn.disabled = true;
      confirmOrderBtn.textContent = 'Sending to Kitchen...';

      fetch('/tablecart/store', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ table_id: currentTableId }),
      })
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(res => {
          confirmOrderBtn.disabled = false;
          if (res.success) {
            loadCartDetails();
            refreshCart();
            pollOrderStatus();
          } else {
            alert(res.message || 'Could not place order.');
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {
          confirmOrderBtn.disabled = false;
          alert('Network error while placing order.');
        });
    });
  }

  function refreshCart() {
    fetch('/get-tablecart?show=my')
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(data => {
        const count = data.all_orders_count || 0;
        const total = (data.total || 0).toFixed(2);
        const unconfirmed = data.unconfirmed_item_count || 0;

        const title = document.getElementById('cart-summary-title');
        const subtitle = document.getElementById('cart-summary-subtitle');
        const viewCartBtn = document.getElementById('view-cart-btn');

        if (title && subtitle) {
          if (count > 0) {
            title.textContent = count + ' item' + (count > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' on Table Tab ($' + total + ')';
            subtitle.textContent = unconfirmed > 0 ? (unconfirmed + ' unconfirmed — tap to send to kitchen') : 'All items confirmed to kitchen';
            if (viewCartBtn) viewCartBtn.textContent = 'Review Tab (' + count + ') ↗';
          } else {
            title.textContent = 'Table ' + <%= JSON.stringify(table.table_name) %> + ' Tab';
            subtitle.textContent = 'Add items or tap to review';
            if (viewCartBtn) viewCartBtn.textContent = 'Review & Order ↗';
          }
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }

  // --- 5. FLOOR SERVICE BELL ---
  document.querySelectorAll('.staff-call-btn').forEach((button) => {
    button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const origText = button.textContent;
      const type = button.dataset.type;
      button.disabled = true;
      button.textContent = 'Calling server...';

      const feedback = document.getElementById('staff-call-feedback');
      const message = document.getElementById('staff-call-message');
      const icon = document.getElementById('call-feedback-icon');

      try {
        const response = await fetch(`/staff-call/${currentTableId}`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ type }),
        });
        const data = await response.json();

        if (response.ok && data.success) {
          button.textContent = '✓ Server Alerted';
          if (feedback) {
            feedback.style.display = 'flex';
            feedback.style.background = '#ecfdf5';
            feedback.style.color = '#065f46';
            feedback.style.border = '1px solid #a7f3d0';
          }
          if (icon) icon.textContent = '✓';
          if (message) message.textContent = data.message || 'Floor staff alerted. Someone will be with you shortly!';

          setTimeout(() => {
            button.disabled = false;
            button.textContent = origText;
          }, 15000);
        } else {
          if (feedback) {
            feedback.style.display = 'flex';
            feedback.style.background = '#fffbeb';
            feedback.style.color = '#92400e';
            feedback.style.border = '1px solid #fde68a';
          }
          if (icon) icon.textContent = '⏳';
          if (message) message.textContent = data.message || 'Server already notified. Help is on the way!';
          button.textContent = '⏳ Server on way';

          setTimeout(() => {
            button.disabled = false;
            button.textContent = origText;
          }, 8000);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        button.disabled = false;
        button.textContent = origText;
      }
    });
  });

  refreshCart();
</script>
</code>

function mediaUrl(path) {
  if (!path) return '';
  return path.startsWith('assets/') ? '/' + path : '/uploads/' + path;
}

const totalCategories = categories.length;
const totalDishes = categories.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c.item_count || 0), 0);
const emptyCategories = categories.filter(c => (c.item_count || 0) === 0).length;
%>

<!-- HEADER & ACTIONS -->
<div class="card welcome-card" style="margin-bottom:20px;">
  <div>
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:6px;">
      <span class="badge status-available">● Menu Organization</span>
      <span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);"><%= totalCategories %> Categories Defined</span>
    </div>

<!-- TOAST NOTIFICATION CONTAINER -->
<div id="category-toast" style="display:none;position:fixed;top:24px;right:24px;z-index:99999;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-xl);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;display:none;align-items:center;gap:10px;">

<script>
  (function() {
    const list = document.getElementById('category-list');
    const modal = document.getElementById('category-modal');
    const modalForm = document.getElementById('category-modal-form');
    const modalHeadline = document.getElementById('modal-headline');
    const catIdInput = document.getElementById('cat-id-input');
    const catNameInput = document.getElementById('cat-name-input');
    const catDescInput = document.getElementById('cat-desc-input');
    const catImageInput = document.getElementById('cat-image-input');
    const imgPreviewWrapper = document.getElementById('image-preview-wrapper');
    const imgPreviewThumb = document.getElementById('image-preview-thumb');
    const imgPreviewLabel = document.getElementById('image-preview-label');
    const openAddBtn = document.getElementById('open-add-modal-btn');
    const closeBtn = document.getElementById('close-modal-btn');
    const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('cancel-modal-btn');
    const saveBtn = document.getElementById('save-modal-btn');
    const toast = document.getElementById('category-toast');
    const toastText = document.getElementById('toast-text');
    const toastIcon = document.getElementById('toast-icon');

    // Toast helper
    function showToast(message, isError = false) {
      toastText.textContent = message;
      toastIcon.textContent = isError ? '⚠️' : '✓';
      toast.style.background = isError ? '#fef2f2' : '#ecfdf5';
      toast.style.color = isError ? '#991b1b' : '#065f46';
      toast.style.border = isError ? '1px solid #fecaca' : '1px solid #a7f3d0';
      toast.style.display = 'flex';
      setTimeout(() => {
        toast.style.display = 'none';
      }, 3500);
    }

    // Modal helpers
    window.openCreateModal = function() {
      modalHeadline.textContent = 'Add New Category';
      catIdInput.value = '';
      catNameInput.value = '';
      catDescInput.value = '';
      catImageInput.value = '';
      imgPreviewWrapper.style.display = 'none';
      modal.style.display = 'flex';
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      setTimeout(() => catNameInput.focus(), 50);
    };

    function openEditModal(btn) {
      modalHeadline.textContent = 'Edit Category';
      catIdInput.value = btn.dataset.id;
      catNameInput.value = btn.dataset.name;
      catDescInput.value = btn.dataset.desc;
      catImageInput.value = '';

      if (btn.dataset.image) {
        imgPreviewThumb.src = btn.dataset.image;
        imgPreviewLabel.textContent = 'Current image';
        imgPreviewWrapper.style.display = 'flex';
      } else {
        imgPreviewWrapper.style.display = 'none';
      }

      modal.style.display = 'flex';
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      setTimeout(() => catNameInput.focus(), 50);
    }

    function closeModal() {
      modal.style.display = 'none';
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    if (openAddBtn) openAddBtn.addEventListener('click', openCreateModal);
    if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
    if (cancelBtn) cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
    modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === modal) closeModal();
    });

    // Live file image preview
    catImageInput.addEventListener('change', function() {
      const file = this.files[0];
      if (file) {
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = function(e) {
          imgPreviewThumb.src = e.target.result;
          imgPreviewLabel.textContent = 'New upload: ' + file.name;
          imgPreviewWrapper.style.display = 'flex';
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
      }
    });

    // Edit button clicks
    document.querySelectorAll('.edit-cat-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => openEditModal(btn));
    });

    // AJAX Form Submission
    modalForm.addEventListener('submit', async function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      saveBtn.disabled = true;
      saveBtn.textContent = 'Saving...';

      const formData = new FormData(modalForm);

      try {
        const response = await fetch('/categories', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest', 'Accept': 'application/json' },
          body: formData,
        });

        if (response.ok) {
          closeModal();
          showToast('Category saved successfully!');
          setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 600);
        } else {
          const err = await response.json();
          alert(err.message || 'Could not save category.');
          saveBtn.disabled = false;
          saveBtn.textContent = 'Save Category';
        }
      } catch (err) {
        // Fallback to standard form post
        modalForm.method = 'POST';
        modalForm.action = '/categories';
        modalForm.submit();
      }
    });

    // Delete confirmation with safety check
    document.querySelectorAll('.delete-cat-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const count = parseInt(btn.dataset.count, 10);
        const name = btn.dataset.name;

        if (count > 0) {
          alert(`Cannot delete "${name}" because it still has ${count} menu item(s). Please move or delete its items first.`);
          return;
        }

        if (!confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete category "${name}"?`)) {
          return;
        }

        try {
          const res = await fetch(`/categories/${btn.dataset.id}/delete`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest', 'Accept': 'application/json' },
          });
          const data = await res.json();
          if (res.ok && data.success) {
            showToast(`Deleted category "${name}"`);
            const card = btn.closest('.category-row-card');
            if (card) {
              card.style.opacity = '0';
              setTimeout(() => {
                card.remove();
                updateOrderNumbers();
              }, 250);
            }
          } else {
            alert(data.message || 'Failed to delete category.');
          }
        } catch (err) {
          // Fallback form post
          const form = document.createElement('form');
          form.method = 'POST';
          form.action = `/categories/${btn.dataset.id}/delete`;
          document.body.appendChild(form);
          form.submit();
        }
      });
    });

    // Reordering persistence
    function updateOrderNumbers() {
      const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.category-row-card');
      const orderPayload = [];

      cards.forEach((card, index) => {
        const badge = card.querySelector('.order-badge');
        if (badge) badge.textContent = '#' + (index + 1);
        card.dataset.order = index + 1;
        orderPayload.push({ id: parseInt(card.dataset.id, 10), order: index + 1 });
      });

      fetch('/category/update-order', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ order_ids: orderPayload }),
      })
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(res => {
        if (res.success) {
          showToast('Menu order updated!');
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    }

    // Up / Down Stepper Buttons
    document.querySelectorAll('.move-up-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const card = btn.closest('.category-row-card');
        const prev = card.previousElementSibling;
        if (prev && prev.classList.contains('category-row-card')) {
          card.parentNode.insertBefore(card, prev);
          updateOrderNumbers();
        }
      });
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.move-down-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const card = btn.closest('.category-row-card');
        const next = card.nextElementSibling;
        if (next && next.classList.contains('category-row-card')) {
          card.parentNode.insertBefore(next, card);
          updateOrderNumbers();
        }
      });
    });

    // HTML5 Drag and Drop Reordering
    let draggedCard = null;

    if (list) {
      list.querySelectorAll('.category-row-card').forEach(card => {
        card.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => {
          draggedCard = card;
          card.classList.add('dragging');
          e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
        });

        card.addEventListener('dragend', () => {
          card.classList.remove('dragging');
          list.querySelectorAll('.category-row-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('drag-over'));
          updateOrderNumbers();
        });

        card.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
          const target = e.target.closest('.category-row-card');
          if (target && target !== draggedCard) {
            target.classList.add('drag-over');
          }
        });

        card.addEventListener('dragleave', (e) => {
          const target = e.target.closest('.category-row-card');
          if (target) target.classList.remove('drag-over');
        });

        card.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          const target = e.target.closest('.category-row-card');
          if (target && target !== draggedCard) {
            target.classList.remove('drag-over');
            const allCards = Array.from(list.querySelectorAll('.category-row-card'));
            const fromIdx = allCards.indexOf(draggedCard);
            const toIdx = allCards.indexOf(target);

            if (fromIdx < toIdx) {
              list.insertBefore(draggedCard, target.nextSibling);
            } else {
              list.insertBefore(draggedCard, target);
            }
          }
        });
      });
    }

    // Live Search & Filter
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('category-search');
    const filterBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.cat-filter-btn');
    let currentFilter = 'all';

    function filterCards() {
      const q = (searchInput ? searchInput.value : '').toLowerCase().trim();
      document.querySelectorAll('.category-row-card').forEach(card => {
        const name = card.dataset.name || '';
        const desc = card.dataset.desc || '';
        const count = parseInt(card.dataset.count, 10);

        const matchesSearch = !q || name.includes(q) || desc.includes(q);
        let matchesFilter = true;

        if (currentFilter === 'with-items') {
          matchesFilter = count > 0;
        } else if (currentFilter === 'empty') {
          matchesFilter = count === 0;
        }

        card.style.display = (matchesSearch && matchesFilter) ? 'block' : 'none';
      });
    }

    if (searchInput) {
      searchInput.addEventListener('input', filterCards);
    }

    filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        filterBtns.forEach(b => {
          b.style.background = '#fff';
          b.style.color = 'var(--ink-secondary)';
          b.style.borderColor = 'var(--line)';
        });
        btn.style.background = 'var(--brand)';
        btn.style.color = '#fff';
        btn.style.borderColor = 'var(--brand)';

        currentFilter = btn.dataset.filter;
        filterCards();
      });
    });

  })();
</script>
</code>

  <form method="POST" action="/customers/<%= customer.id %>" style="display:grid;gap:16px;">

function toHHMM(t) {
  if (!t) return '';
  return t.slice(0, 5); // "HH:MM:SS" -> "HH:MM" for <input type=time>
}
%>

  <h2><%= discount ? 'Edit' : 'Add' %> discount</h2>

    <div class="message"><% errors.forEach(function(e) { %><div><%= e %></div><% }) %></div>
  <% } %>

  <form method="POST" action="<%= discount ? '/discounts/' + discount.id : '/discounts' %>">
    <label>Start time</label>
    <input type="time" name="start_time" value="<%= discount ? toHHMM(discount.start_time) : '' %>" required>

    <label>End time</label>
    <input type="time" name="end_time" value="<%= discount ? toHHMM(discount.end_time) : '' %>" required>

    <label>Discount percentage</label>
    <input type="number" name="discount_percentage" min="1" max="100" value="<%= discount ? discount.discount_percentage : '' %>" required>

    <label>Days</label>
    <% days.forEach(function(day) { %>
      <label style="display:block;">

          <%= discount && discount.days && discount.days.includes(day) ? 'checked' : '' %>>

      </label>
    <% }) %>

<script>
  const searchInput = document.getElementById('inventory-search');
  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.inventory-item-card');
  const filterBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-stock-btn');
  let currentFilter = 'all';

  function filterItems() {
    const q = (searchInput ? searchInput.value : '').toLowerCase().trim();

    cards.forEach(card => {
      const name = card.dataset.name;
      const unit = card.dataset.unit;
      const status = card.dataset.status;

      const matchesSearch = !q || name.includes(q) || unit.includes(q);
      let matchesFilter = true;

      if (currentFilter === 'low') {
        matchesFilter = status === 'low' || status === 'out';
      } else if (currentFilter === 'healthy') {
        matchesFilter = status === 'healthy';
      }

      card.style.display = (matchesSearch && matchesFilter) ? 'block' : 'none';
    });
  }

  if (searchInput) {
    searchInput.addEventListener('input', filterItems);
  }

  filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      filterBtns.forEach(b => {
        b.style.background = '#fff';
        b.style.color = 'var(--ink-secondary)';
        b.style.border = '1px solid var(--line)';
      });
      btn.style.background = 'var(--brand)';
      btn.style.color = '#fff';
      btn.style.border = '1px solid var(--brand)';

      currentFilter = btn.dataset.filter;
      filterItems();
    });
  });
</script>


</code>

<script>
  const hasVariantsCb = document.getElementById('has_variants');
  const hasToppingsCb = document.getElementById('has_toppings');
  const priceField = document.getElementById('price-field');
  const variantsField = document.getElementById('variants-field');
  const toppingsField = document.getElementById('toppings-field');

  hasVariantsCb.addEventListener('change', () => {
    priceField.style.display = hasVariantsCb.checked ? 'none' : '';
    variantsField.style.display = hasVariantsCb.checked ? '' : 'none';
  });
  hasToppingsCb.addEventListener('change', () => {
    toppingsField.style.display = hasToppingsCb.checked ? '' : 'none';
  });

  document.getElementById('add-variant-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'item-row';
    row.innerHTML = '<input type="text" placeholder="Name" data-variant-name style="width:55%;">' +
      '<input type="number" placeholder="Price" data-variant-price style="width:35%;">';
    document.getElementById('variants-list').appendChild(row);
  });

    const row = document.createElement('div');

      '<input type="number" placeholder="Price" data-topping-price style="width:35%;">';

  });

  // right before submit, since this is a plain (non-JS-fetch) form post.
  document.getElementById('menu-form').addEventListener('submit', () => {
    const variantInputs = document.getElementById('hidden-variant-inputs');
    document.querySelectorAll('#variants-list .item-row').forEach((row, i) => {
      const name = row.querySelector('[data-variant-name]').value;
      const price = row.querySelector('[data-variant-price]').value;
      if (name) {
        variantInputs.innerHTML += `<input type="hidden" name="variants[${i}][name]" value="${name}">` +
          `<input type="hidden" name="variants[${i}][price]" value="${price}">`;
      }
    });
    const toppingInputs = document.getElementById('hidden-topping-inputs');
    document.querySelectorAll('#toppings-list .item-row').forEach((row, i) => {
      const name = row.querySelector('[data-topping-name]').value;
      const price = row.querySelector('[data-topping-price]').value;
      if (name) {
        toppingInputs.innerHTML += `<input type="hidden" name="toppings[${i}][name]" value="${name}">` +
          `<input type="hidden" name="toppings[${i}][price]" value="${price}">`;
      }
    });
  });

<script>
  (function() {
    const list = document.getElementById('menu-items-container');
    const toast = document.getElementById('menu-toast');
    const toastText = document.getElementById('toast-text');
    const toastIcon = document.getElementById('toast-icon');

    // Toast Alert Helper
    function showToast(message, isError = false) {
      toastText.textContent = message;
      toastIcon.textContent = isError ? '⚠️' : '✓';
      toast.style.background = isError ? '#fef2f2' : '#ecfdf5';
      toast.style.color = isError ? '#991b1b' : '#065f46';
      toast.style.border = isError ? '1px solid #fecaca' : '1px solid #a7f3d0';
      toast.style.display = 'flex';
      setTimeout(() => {
        toast.style.display = 'none';
      }, 3000);
    }

    // Live AJAX 86 (Sold-Out) Toggle
    document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-sold-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const id = btn.dataset.id;
        const name = btn.dataset.name;
        btn.disabled = true;

        try {
          const response = await fetch(`/menus/${id}/toggle-sold-out`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
              'Accept': 'application/json',
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            }
          });

          const data = await response.json();
          btn.disabled = false;

          if (response.ok && data.success) {
            const card = btn.closest('.menu-item-card');
            card.dataset.soldOut = data.sold_out ? 'true' : 'false';

            if (data.sold_out) {
              card.classList.add('is-sold-out');
              btn.classList.remove('btn-secondary');
              btn.classList.add('btn-danger');
              btn.textContent = '⚠️ 86 (Sold out)';
              showToast(`"${name}" is now marked 86 / Sold Out`);
            } else {
              card.classList.remove('is-sold-out');
              btn.classList.remove('btn-danger');
              btn.classList.add('btn-secondary');
              btn.textContent = '✓ Available';
              showToast(`"${name}" is now back in stock!`);
            }
          } else {
            alert(data.message || 'Could not update item availability.');
          }
        } catch (err) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          alert('Network error while toggling item status.');
        }
      });
    });

    // Delete item with AJAX
    document.querySelectorAll('.delete-menu-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const id = btn.dataset.id;
        const name = btn.dataset.name;

        if (!confirm(`Are you sure you want to permanently delete "${name}" from the menu?`)) {
          return;
        }

        btn.disabled = true;

        try {
          const res = await fetch(`/menus/${id}/delete`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
              'Accept': 'application/json',
            }
          });

          if (res.ok) {
            const card = btn.closest('.menu-item-card');
            if (card) {
              card.style.opacity = '0';
              card.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';
              setTimeout(() => {
                card.remove();
                updateOrderNumbers();
              }, 250);
            }
            showToast(`Deleted "${name}"`);
          } else {
            btn.disabled = false;
            alert('Failed to delete menu item.');
          }
        } catch (err) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          alert('Network error while deleting item.');
        }
      });
    });

    // Persist Reordering
    function updateOrderNumbers() {
      const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item-card');
      const orderPayload = [];

      cards.forEach((card, index) => {
        const badge = card.querySelector('.order-badge');
        if (badge) badge.textContent = '#' + (index + 1);
        card.dataset.order = index + 1;
        orderPayload.push({ id: parseInt(card.dataset.id, 10), order: index + 1 });
      });

      fetch('/menu/update-order', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ order_ids: orderPayload }),
      })
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(res => {
        if (res.success) {
          showToast('Menu order saved!');
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    }

    // Up / Down Stepper Handlers
    document.querySelectorAll('.move-up-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const card = btn.closest('.menu-item-card');
        const prev = card.previousElementSibling;
        if (prev && prev.classList.contains('menu-item-card')) {
          card.parentNode.insertBefore(card, prev);
          updateOrderNumbers();
        }
      });
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.move-down-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const card = btn.closest('.menu-item-card');
        const next = card.nextElementSibling;
        if (next && next.classList.contains('menu-item-card')) {
          card.parentNode.insertBefore(next, card);
          updateOrderNumbers();
        }
      });
    });

    // Drag-and-Drop Reordering
    let draggedCard = null;

    if (list) {
      list.querySelectorAll('.menu-item-card').forEach(card => {
        card.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => {
          draggedCard = card;
          card.classList.add('dragging');
          e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
        });

        card.addEventListener('dragend', () => {
          card.classList.remove('dragging');
          list.querySelectorAll('.menu-item-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('drag-over'));
          updateOrderNumbers();
        });

        card.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
          const target = e.target.closest('.menu-item-card');
          if (target && target !== draggedCard) {
            target.classList.add('drag-over');
          }
        });

        card.addEventListener('dragleave', (e) => {
          const target = e.target.closest('.menu-item-card');
          if (target) target.classList.remove('drag-over');
        });

        card.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          const target = e.target.closest('.menu-item-card');
          if (target && target !== draggedCard) {
            target.classList.remove('drag-over');
            const allCards = Array.from(list.querySelectorAll('.menu-item-card'));
            const fromIdx = allCards.indexOf(draggedCard);
            const toIdx = allCards.indexOf(target);

            if (fromIdx < toIdx) {
              list.insertBefore(draggedCard, target.nextSibling);
            } else {
              list.insertBefore(draggedCard, target);
            }
          }
        });
      });
    }

    // Live Search & Multi-Filter Logic
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('menu-search-input');
    const categorySelect = document.getElementById('filter-category-select');
    const filterChips = document.querySelectorAll('.menu-filter-chip');
    let currentStationFilter = 'all';

    function filterDishes() {
      const q = (searchInput ? searchInput.value : '').toLowerCase().trim();
      const selectedCategory = categorySelect ? categorySelect.value : 'all';

      document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item-card').forEach(card => {
        const name = card.dataset.name || '';
        const desc = card.dataset.desc || '';
        const catId = card.dataset.categoryId || '';
        const isDrink = card.dataset.isDrink === 'true';
        const isSoldOut = card.dataset.soldOut === 'true';

        // 1. Text Search
        const matchesSearch = !q || name.includes(q) || desc.includes(q);

        // 2. Category selection
        const matchesCategory = selectedCategory === 'all' || catId === selectedCategory;

        // 3. Station / Availability chip filter
        let matchesChip = true;
        if (currentStationFilter === 'food') {
          matchesChip = !isDrink;
        } else if (currentStationFilter === 'drinks') {
          matchesChip = isDrink;
        } else if (currentStationFilter === 'soldout') {
          matchesChip = isSoldOut;
        } else if (currentStationFilter === 'available') {
          matchesChip = !isSoldOut;
        }

        card.style.display = (matchesSearch && matchesCategory && matchesChip) ? 'block' : 'none';
      });
    }

    if (searchInput) {
      searchInput.addEventListener('input', filterDishes);
    }
    if (categorySelect) {
      categorySelect.addEventListener('change', filterDishes);
    }

    filterChips.forEach(chip => {
      chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
        filterChips.forEach(c => {
          c.style.background = '#fff';
          c.style.color = 'var(--ink-secondary)';
          c.style.borderColor = 'var(--line)';
        });
        chip.style.background = 'var(--brand)';
        chip.style.color = '#fff';
        chip.style.borderColor = 'var(--brand)';

        currentStationFilter = chip.dataset.filter;
        filterDishes();
      });
    });

  })();
</script>
</code>

<script>
  // Instant AJAX update on status form submit
  document.querySelectorAll('form[action$="/status"]').forEach(form => {
    form.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      const submitBtn = form.querySelector('button');
      if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = true;
      const response = await fetch(form.action, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
        body: new URLSearchParams(new FormData(form))
      });
      if (response.ok) {
        location.reload();
      } else {
        alert('Reservation status could not be updated.');
        if (submitBtn) submitBtn.disabled = false;
      }
    });
  });

  // Filter chips
  const filterBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.res-filter-btn');
  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.res-card');
  filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      filterBtns.forEach(b => {
        b.style.background = '#fff';
        b.style.color = 'var(--ink-secondary)';
        b.style.borderColor = 'var(--line)';
      });
      btn.style.background = 'var(--brand)';
      btn.style.color = '#fff';
      btn.style.borderColor = 'var(--brand)';

      const f = btn.dataset.filter;
      cards.forEach(card => {
        if (f === 'all' || card.dataset.status === f) {
          card.style.display = 'block';
        } else {
          card.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });
    });
  });
</script>

<script>
  (function() {
    const toast = document.getElementById('table-toast');
    const toastText = document.getElementById('toast-text');
    const toastIcon = document.getElementById('toast-icon');

    // Toast helper
    function showToast(message, isError = false) {
      toastText.textContent = message;
      toastIcon.textContent = isError ? '⚠️' : '✓';
      toast.style.background = isError ? '#fef2f2' : '#ecfdf5';
      toast.style.color = isError ? '#991b1b' : '#065f46';
      toast.style.border = isError ? '1px solid #fecaca' : '1px solid #a7f3d0';
      toast.style.display = 'flex';
      setTimeout(() => { toast.style.display = 'none'; }, 3000);
    }

    // Modal: Table Add / Edit
    const tableModal = document.getElementById('table-modal');
    const tableForm = document.getElementById('table-modal-form');
    const tableHeadline = document.getElementById('table-modal-title');
    const tableIdInput = document.getElementById('table-modal-id');
    const tableNameInput = document.getElementById('table-modal-name');
    const tableSlugInput = document.getElementById('table-modal-slug');
    const openAddBtn = document.getElementById('open-add-table-modal');
    const closeTableBtn = document.getElementById('close-table-modal-btn');
    const cancelTableBtn = document.getElementById('cancel-table-modal-btn');
    const saveTableBtn = document.getElementById('save-table-modal-btn');

    window.openCreateTableModal = function() {
      tableHeadline.textContent = 'Add Floor Table';
      tableIdInput.value = '';
      tableNameInput.value = '';
      tableSlugInput.value = '';
      tableModal.style.display = 'flex';
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      setTimeout(() => tableNameInput.focus(), 50);
    };

    function openEditTableModal(btn) {
      tableHeadline.textContent = 'Edit Table';
      tableIdInput.value = btn.dataset.id;
      tableNameInput.value = btn.dataset.name;
      tableSlugInput.value = btn.dataset.slug;
      tableModal.style.display = 'flex';
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      setTimeout(() => tableNameInput.focus(), 50);
    }

    function closeTableModal() {
      tableModal.style.display = 'none';
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    if (openAddBtn) openAddBtn.addEventListener('click', openCreateTableModal);
    if (closeTableBtn) closeTableBtn.addEventListener('click', closeTableModal);
    if (cancelTableBtn) cancelTableBtn.addEventListener('click', closeTableModal);
    tableModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === tableModal) closeTableModal();
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.edit-table-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => openEditTableModal(btn));
    });

    // Save Table AJAX Submit
    tableForm.addEventListener('submit', async function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      saveTableBtn.disabled = true;
      saveTableBtn.textContent = 'Saving...';

      const formData = new URLSearchParams(new FormData(tableForm));

      try {
        const res = await fetch('/tables', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
            'Accept': 'application/json',
            'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
          },
          body: formData.toString()
        });

        if (res.ok) {
          closeTableModal();
          showToast('Table saved successfully!');
          setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 500);
        } else {
          const err = await res.json();
          alert(err.message || 'Could not save table.');
          saveTableBtn.disabled = false;
          saveTableBtn.textContent = 'Save Table';
        }
      } catch (err) {
        tableForm.method = 'POST';
        tableForm.action = '/tables';
        tableForm.submit();
      }
    });

    // Delete Table
    document.querySelectorAll('.delete-table-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const id = btn.dataset.id;
        const name = btn.dataset.name;

        if (!confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete "${name}"? This removes any active sessions on this table.`)) {
          return;
        }

        btn.disabled = true;
        try {
          const res = await fetch(`/tables/${id}/delete`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
              'Accept': 'application/json',
            }
          });
          if (res.ok) {
            const card = btn.closest('.table-manage-card');
            if (card) {
              card.style.opacity = '0';
              card.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';
              setTimeout(() => card.remove(), 250);
            }
            showToast(`Deleted "${name}"`);
          } else {
            btn.disabled = false;
            alert('Failed to delete table.');
          }
        } catch (err) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          alert('Network error while deleting table.');
        }
      });
    });

    // Reset / Free Table
    document.querySelectorAll('.reset-table-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const id = btn.dataset.id;
        const name = btn.dataset.name;

        if (!confirm(`Reset "${name}" to Available? This clears active unbilled orders and frees the table.`)) {
          return;
        }

        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = 'Freeing...';

        try {
          const res = await fetch(`/tables/${id}/reset`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'Accept': 'application/json',
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            },
          });

          const data = await res.json();
          if (res.ok && data.success) {
            showToast(data.message || `"${name}" is now Available!`);
            setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 400);
          } else {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = '🔄 Free Table';
            alert('Server error: ' + (data.message || res.statusText));
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.error('Reset fetch failed, falling back to form submit:', err);
          // Automatic graceful fallback: submit via standard form so it works regardless of browser fetch policies
          const form = document.createElement('form');
          form.method = 'POST';
          form.action = `/tables/${id}/reset`;
          document.body.appendChild(form);
          form.submit();
        }
      });
    });

    // QR Stand Modal
    const qrModal = document.getElementById('table-qr-modal');
    const closeQrBtn = document.getElementById('close-qr-modal-btn');
    const titleEl = document.getElementById('modal-table-title');
    const badgeEl = document.getElementById('modal-table-badge');
    const placardTableEl = document.getElementById('placard-table-name');
    const qrImgEl = document.getElementById('placard-qr-img');
    const urlTextEl = document.getElementById('placard-url-text');
    const urlInputEl = document.getElementById('modal-url-input');
    const copyBtn = document.getElementById('copy-url-btn');
    const copyStatusEl = document.getElementById('copy-status-msg');
    const printBtn = document.getElementById('print-placard-btn');
    const downloadBtn = document.getElementById('download-qr-png-btn');
    const previewBtn = document.getElementById('preview-customer-menu-btn');
    const printAllBtn = document.getElementById('print-all-placards-btn');

    function openQrModal(data) {
      titleEl.textContent = 'Table ' + data.name.replace(/^Table\s*/i, '') + ' QR Stand';
      badgeEl.textContent = '● ' + (data.status || 'available').replace(/_/g, ' ');
      placardTableEl.textContent = data.name.replace(/^Table\s*/i, '');

      const absoluteUrl = data.url.startsWith('http') ? data.url : (window.location.origin + data.url);
      urlTextEl.textContent = absoluteUrl;
      urlInputEl.value = absoluteUrl;
      previewBtn.href = absoluteUrl;
      downloadBtn.href = '/tables/' + data.id + '/qr-download';
      downloadBtn.download = 'table-' + data.slug + '-qr.png';
      copyStatusEl.textContent = '';

      if (data.image) {
        qrImgEl.src = data.image;
      } else {
        qrImgEl.src = '/tables/' + data.id + '/qr-download';
      }

      qrModal.style.display = 'flex';
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }

    function closeQrModal() {
      qrModal.style.display = 'none';
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
      document.body.classList.remove('print-single', 'print-batch');
    }

    closeQrBtn.addEventListener('click', closeQrModal);
    qrModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === qrModal) closeQrModal();
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.open-qr-modal-btn, .quick-qr-thumbnail').forEach(el => {
      el.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const btn = el.classList.contains('open-qr-modal-btn') ? el : el.closest('.table-manage-card').querySelector('.open-qr-modal-btn');
        if (!btn) return;
        openQrModal({
          id: btn.dataset.tableId,
          name: btn.dataset.tableName,
          slug: btn.dataset.tableSlug,
          status: btn.dataset.tableStatus,
          url: btn.dataset.menuUrl,
          image: btn.dataset.qrImage
        });
      });
    });

    // Copy URL
    copyBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!urlInputEl.value) return;
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(urlInputEl.value)
        .then(() => {
          copyStatusEl.textContent = '✓ Copied table URL to clipboard!';
          setTimeout(() => { copyStatusEl.textContent = ''; }, 2500);
        })
        .catch(() => {
          urlInputEl.select();
          document.execCommand('copy');
          copyStatusEl.textContent = '✓ Copied!';
          setTimeout(() => { copyStatusEl.textContent = ''; }, 2500);
        });
    });

    // Print Single Table Stand
    printBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      document.body.classList.remove('print-batch');
      document.body.classList.add('print-single');
      window.print();
    });

    // Print All Table Stands in Batch
    if (printAllBtn) {
      printAllBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.body.classList.remove('print-single');
        document.body.classList.add('print-batch');
        window.print();
      });
    }

    window.addEventListener('afterprint', () => {
      document.body.classList.remove('print-single', 'print-batch');
    });

    // Search and Status Filtering
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('table-search-input');
    const filterButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.table-filter-btn');
    let currentFilter = 'all';

    function filterTables() {
      const q = (searchInput ? searchInput.value : '').toLowerCase().trim();

      document.querySelectorAll('.table-manage-card').forEach(card => {
        const name = card.dataset.name || '';
        const slug = card.dataset.slug || '';
        const status = card.dataset.status || 'available';

        const matchesSearch = !q || name.includes(q) || slug.includes(q);
        const matchesStatus = currentFilter === 'all' || status === currentFilter;

        card.style.display = (matchesSearch && matchesStatus) ? 'flex' : 'none';
      });
    }

    if (searchInput) searchInput.addEventListener('input', filterTables);

    filterButtons.forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        filterButtons.forEach(b => {
          b.style.background = '#fff';
          b.style.color = 'var(--ink-secondary)';
          b.style.borderColor = 'var(--line)';
        });
        btn.style.background = 'var(--brand)';
        btn.style.color = '#fff';
        btn.style.borderColor = 'var(--brand)';

        currentFilter = btn.dataset.filter;
        filterTables();
      });
    });

  })();
</script>
</code>

<code>
<%
const totalStaff = waiters.length;
const waiterCount = waiters.filter(w => w.user_role === 'waiter').length;
const kitchenCount = waiters.filter(w => w.user_type === 'K').length;
const counterCount = waiters.filter(w => w.user_type === 'Co').length;

function getRoleInfo(member) {
  if (member.user_type === 'K') {
    return { name: 'Kitchen Chef', badgeClass: 'background:#fff1f2;color:#be123c;border:1px solid #fecdd3;', icon: '👨‍🍳', key: 'kitchen' };
  }
  if (member.user_type === 'Co') {
    return { name: 'Counter Cashier', badgeClass: 'background:#eff6ff;color:#1e40af;border:1px solid #bfdbfe;', icon: '💳', key: 'counter' };
  }

<script>
  (function() {
    const toast = document.getElementById('staff-toast');
    const toastText = document.getElementById('toast-text');
    const toastIcon = document.getElementById('toast-icon');

    // Toast helper
    function showToast(message, isError = false) {
      toastText.textContent = message;
      toastIcon.textContent = isError ? '⚠️' : '✓';
      toast.style.background = isError ? '#fef2f2' : '#ecfdf5';
      toast.style.color = isError ? '#991b1b' : '#065f46';
      toast.style.border = isError ? '1px solid #fecaca' : '1px solid #a7f3d0';
      toast.style.display = 'flex';
      setTimeout(() => { toast.style.display = 'none'; }, 3000);
    }

    // Modal elements
    const staffModal = document.getElementById('staff-modal');
    const staffForm = document.getElementById('staff-modal-form');
    const staffHeadline = document.getElementById('staff-modal-title');
    const staffIdInput = document.getElementById('staff-modal-id');
    const staffNameInput = document.getElementById('staff-modal-name');
    const staffEmailInput = document.getElementById('staff-modal-email');
    const staffRoleInput = document.getElementById('staff-modal-role');
    const staffPasswordInput = document.getElementById('staff-modal-password');
    const staffConfirmInput = document.getElementById('staff-modal-password-confirm');
    const passwordHint = document.getElementById('password-hint');
    const lblPassword = document.getElementById('lbl-staff-password');
    const lblConfirm = document.getElementById('lbl-staff-confirm');
    const openAddBtn = document.getElementById('open-add-staff-modal');
    const closeBtn = document.getElementById('close-staff-modal-btn');
    const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('cancel-staff-modal-btn');
    const saveBtn = document.getElementById('save-staff-modal-btn');

    window.openCreateStaffModal = function() {
      staffHeadline.textContent = 'Add Team Member';
      staffIdInput.value = '';
      staffNameInput.value = '';
      staffEmailInput.value = '';
      staffRoleInput.value = 'waiter';
      staffPasswordInput.value = '';
      staffConfirmInput.value = '';
      staffPasswordInput.required = true;
      staffConfirmInput.required = true;
      lblPassword.textContent = 'Password *';
      lblConfirm.textContent = 'Confirm Password *';
      passwordHint.style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('staff-modal-phone').value = '';
      document.getElementById('staff-modal-address').value = '';

      staffModal.style.display = 'flex';
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      setTimeout(() => staffNameInput.focus(), 50);
    };

    function openEditStaffModal(btn) {
      staffHeadline.textContent = 'Edit Team Member Profile';
      staffIdInput.value = btn.dataset.id;
      staffNameInput.value = btn.dataset.name;
      staffEmailInput.value = btn.dataset.email;
      staffRoleInput.value = btn.dataset.role || 'waiter';
      staffPasswordInput.value = '';
      staffConfirmInput.value = '';
      staffPasswordInput.required = false;
      staffConfirmInput.required = false;
      lblPassword.textContent = 'New Password (Optional)';
      lblConfirm.textContent = 'Confirm New Password';
      passwordHint.style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('staff-modal-phone').value = btn.dataset.phone || '';
      document.getElementById('staff-modal-address').value = btn.dataset.address || '';

      staffModal.style.display = 'flex';
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      setTimeout(() => staffNameInput.focus(), 50);
    }

    function closeStaffModal() {
      staffModal.style.display = 'none';
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    if (openAddBtn) openAddBtn.addEventListener('click', openCreateStaffModal);
    if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeStaffModal);
    if (cancelBtn) cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', closeStaffModal);
    staffModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === staffModal) closeStaffModal();
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.edit-staff-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => openEditStaffModal(btn));
    });

    // Form Submit via AJAX
    staffForm.addEventListener('submit', async function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      saveBtn.disabled = true;
      saveBtn.textContent = 'Saving...';

      const id = staffIdInput.value;
      const url = id ? `/waiters/${id}` : '/waiters';
      const formData = new URLSearchParams(new FormData(staffForm));

      try {
        const res = await fetch(url, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
            'Accept': 'application/json',
            'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
          },
          body: formData.toString()
        });

        const data = await res.json();
        if (res.ok && data.success) {
          closeStaffModal();
          showToast('Team member saved successfully!');
          setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 500);
        } else {
          saveBtn.disabled = false;
          saveBtn.textContent = 'Save Team Member';
          const errorMsg = data.errors ? data.errors.join('\n') : (data.message || 'Could not save staff member.');
          alert(errorMsg);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        staffForm.method = 'POST';
        staffForm.action = url;
        staffForm.submit();
      }
    });

    // Delete Staff Member
    document.querySelectorAll('.delete-staff-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const id = btn.dataset.id;
        const name = btn.dataset.name;

        if (!confirm(`Are you sure you want to remove "${name}" from your team?`)) {
          return;
        }

        btn.disabled = true;

        try {
          const res = await fetch(`/waiters/${id}/delete`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
              'Accept': 'application/json',
            }
          });

          if (res.ok) {
            const card = btn.closest('.staff-card');
            if (card) {
              card.style.opacity = '0';
              card.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';
              setTimeout(() => card.remove(), 250);
            }
            showToast(`Removed "${name}" from team`);
          } else {
            btn.disabled = false;
            alert('Failed to remove staff member.');
          }
        } catch (err) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          alert('Network error while deleting staff member.');
        }
      });
    });

    // Search and Role Filter
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('staff-search-input');
    const filterButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.staff-filter-btn');
    let currentFilter = 'all';

    function filterStaff() {
      const q = (searchInput ? searchInput.value : '').toLowerCase().trim();

      document.querySelectorAll('.staff-card').forEach(card => {
        const name = card.dataset.name || '';
        const email = card.dataset.email || '';
        const role = card.dataset.role || '';

        const matchesSearch = !q || name.includes(q) || email.includes(q) || role.includes(q);
        const matchesRole = currentFilter === 'all' || role === currentFilter;

        card.style.display = (matchesSearch && matchesRole) ? 'flex' : 'none';
      });
    }

    if (searchInput) searchInput.addEventListener('input', filterStaff);

    filterButtons.forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        filterButtons.forEach(b => {
          b.style.background = '#fff';
          b.style.color = 'var(--ink-secondary)';
          b.style.borderColor = 'var(--line)';
        });
        btn.style.background = 'var(--brand)';
        btn.style.color = '#fff';
        btn.style.borderColor = 'var(--brand)';

        currentFilter = btn.dataset.filter;
        filterStaff();
      });
    });

  })();
</script>
</code>
