<script src="/socket.io/socket.io.js"></script>
<script>
  (function() {
    const restaurantId = <%= restaurant.id %>;
    const slug = '<%= restaurant.slug %>';
    let selectedTableId = null;
    let soundEnabled = true;

    // Web Audio Chime
    const soundBtn = document.getElementById('btn-toggle-sound');
    const soundLabel = document.getElementById('sound-label');
    const soundIcon = document.getElementById('sound-icon');

    soundBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      soundEnabled = !soundEnabled;
      soundLabel.textContent = soundEnabled ? 'Sound: ON' : 'Sound: OFF';
      soundIcon.textContent = soundEnabled ? '🔔' : '🔕';
    });

    function playChime() {
      if (!soundEnabled) return;
      try {
        const ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = ctx.createGain();
        osc.type = 'triangle';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(523.25, ctx.currentTime); // C5
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(659.25, ctx.currentTime + 0.12); // E5
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, ctx.currentTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(ctx.destination);
        osc.start();
        osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // Load and select a table's order panel
    window.loadTableOrders = function(tableId) {
      selectedTableId = tableId;
      document.querySelectorAll('.table-card').forEach(c => {
        c.classList.toggle('selected-table', String(c.dataset.tableId) === String(tableId));
      });

      const panel = document.getElementById('table-orders-panel');
      panel.dataset.tableId = tableId;
      panel.innerHTML = `
        <div class="card" style="margin:0;text-align:center;padding:40px 16px;">
          <div style="font-size:24px;margin-bottom:8px;">⏳</div>
          <p style="color:var(--muted);margin:0;">Loading orders for Table #${tableId}...</p>
        </div>`;

      // On mobile, show bottom sheet
      const inspectorCol = document.querySelector('.counter-inspector-column');
      if (inspectorCol) inspectorCol.classList.add('is-open');

      fetch(`/counter-admin/get_table_orders/${tableId}`)
        .then(r => r.text())
        .then(html => {
          panel.innerHTML = html;
          attachPanelHandlers();
        })
        .catch(() => {
          panel.innerHTML = `<div class="card alert" style="margin:0;">Failed to load table orders.</div>`;
        });
    };

    // Attach in-place AJAX action handlers to order items
    function attachPanelHandlers() {
      const panel = document.getElementById('table-orders-panel');
      if (!panel) return;

      // Single or batch update status
      panel.querySelectorAll('.update-order-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
          const ids = btn.dataset.ids;
          const status = btn.dataset.status;
          btn.disabled = true;
          btn.textContent = 'Updating...';

          try {
            const res = await fetch('/counter-admin/update-order', {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
              body: JSON.stringify({ id: ids, status }),
            });
            const data = await res.json();
            if (data.success) {
              if (selectedTableId) loadTableOrders(selectedTableId);
              refreshTables();
            } else {
              alert(data.message || 'Could not update status');
              btn.disabled = false;
            }
          } catch (e) {
            btn.disabled = false;
          }
        });
      });

      // Void / Cancel Table
      const cancelBtn = panel.querySelector('#cancel-table-btn');
      if (cancelBtn) {
        cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
          if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to cancel and void all items on this table?')) return;
          cancelBtn.disabled = true;
          try {
            await fetch(`/counter-admin/cancel_order/${cancelBtn.dataset.tableId}`);
            selectedTableId = null;
            panel.innerHTML = `
              <div class="card" style="margin:0;text-align:center;padding:48px 20px;">
                <p style="color:var(--muted);">Table order voided and table reset to available.</p>
              </div>`;
            refreshTables();
          } catch (e) {
            cancelBtn.disabled = false;
          }
        });
      }

      // Close mobile inspector
      const closeMobileBtn = panel.querySelector('#close-inspector-mobile');
      if (closeMobileBtn) {
        closeMobileBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const inspectorCol = document.querySelector('.counter-inspector-column');
          if (inspectorCol) inspectorCol.classList.remove('is-open');
        });
      }
    }

    // Bind card clicks
    document.querySelectorAll('.table-card').forEach(card => {
      card.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        // Don't trigger if clicking direct action links like "Settle Bill"
        if (e.target.tagName === 'A' || e.target.closest('a')) return;
        loadTableOrders(card.dataset.tableId);
      });
    });

    // Real-Time Table Updates Polling / Fetching
    function refreshTables() {
      fetch(`/counter-admin/get_table_updates/${restaurantId}`)
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(data => {
          let avail = 0;
          let occ = 0;
          let bill = 0;

          data.tables.forEach(t => {
            const card = document.querySelector(`.table-card[data-table-id="${t.id}"]`);
            if (!card) return;

            card.dataset.status = t.status;
            const badge = card.querySelector('.table-status-badge');
            const isAvail = t.status === 'available';
            const isBill = ['billing', 'bill_requested', 'pending_approval'].includes(t.status);

            if (isAvail) avail++;
            else if (isBill) bill++;
            else occ++;

            card.classList.toggle('table-bill-pulse', isBill);
            card.style.borderColor = isAvail ? 'var(--line)' : (isBill ? '#3b82f6' : (t.status === 'preparing' ? '#f97316' : '#f59e0b'));

            if (badge) {
              badge.textContent = t.status.replaceAll('_', ' ');
              badge.className = 'badge table-status-badge ' + (isAvail ? 'status-available' : (isBill ? 'status-served' : 'status-occupied'));
            }

            const elapsedEl = card.querySelector('.table-elapsed-timer');
            if (elapsedEl && t.start_time) {
              elapsedEl.dataset.startTime = t.start_time;
              updateTimerText(elapsedEl);
            }
          });

          // Update KPI counts
          document.getElementById('stat-available').textContent = avail;
          document.getElementById('stat-occupied').textContent = occ;
          document.getElementById('stat-billing').textContent = bill;
        })
        .catch(() => {});
    }

    function updateTimerText(el) {
      if (!el.dataset.startTime || el.closest('.table-card').dataset.status === 'available') {
        el.textContent = 'Ready for seating';
        return;
      }
      const diffMinutes = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(el.dataset.startTime).getTime()) / 60000);
      el.textContent = diffMinutes <= 0 ? 'Just seated' : `Seated for ${diffMinutes}m`;
    }

    setInterval(() => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.table-elapsed-timer').forEach(updateTimerText);
    }, 30000);

    // Online Orders Drawer Handling
    const onlineBtn = document.getElementById('btn-toggle-online');
    const onlineBadge = document.getElementById('online-order-badge');
    const onlineDrawer = document.getElementById('online-orders-drawer');
    const closeOnlineBtn = document.getElementById('close-online-drawer-btn');
    const onlineContent = document.getElementById('online-orders-content');

    function checkOnlineOrders() {
      fetch(`/counter-admin/get-online-orders/${restaurantId}`)
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(data => {
          if (data.count > 0) {
            onlineBadge.textContent = data.count;
            onlineBadge.style.display = 'inline-block';
          } else {
            onlineBadge.style.display = 'none';
          }
          if (onlineDrawer.style.display !== 'none') {
            renderOnlineOrders(data.html, data.count);
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {});
    }

    function renderOnlineOrders(html, count) {
      if (count === 0) {
        onlineContent.innerHTML = `
          <div style="text-align:center;padding:48px 16px;color:var(--muted);">
            <div style="font-size:32px;margin-bottom:8px;">✓</div>
            <h4 style="margin:0 0 4px;">No Pending Online Orders</h4>
            <p style="margin:0;font-size:13px;">New takeaway orders will show up here automatically.</p>
          </div>`;
        return;
      }
      onlineContent.innerHTML = html;

      // Attach AJAX approve/decline
      onlineContent.querySelectorAll('.approve-order-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
          btn.disabled = true;
          btn.textContent = 'Approving...';
          await fetch(`/counter-admin/approve-order/${btn.dataset.orderId}`, { method: 'POST' });
          checkOnlineOrders();
          refreshTables();
        });
      });

      onlineContent.querySelectorAll('.decline-order-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
          if (!confirm('Decline and cancel this online order?')) return;
          btn.disabled = true;
          await fetch(`/counter-admin/decline-order/${btn.dataset.orderId}`, { method: 'POST' });
          checkOnlineOrders();
        });
      });
    }

    onlineBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      onlineDrawer.style.display = 'flex';
      fetch(`/counter-admin/get-online-orders/${restaurantId}`)
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(data => renderOnlineOrders(data.html, data.count));
    });

    closeOnlineBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      onlineDrawer.style.display = 'none';
    });
    onlineDrawer.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === onlineDrawer) onlineDrawer.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // Real-time Socket.IO Connection
    const socket = io();
    socket.emit('join-restaurant', restaurantId);

    socket.on('restaurant-update', (event) => {
      playChime();
      refreshTables();
      checkOnlineOrders();

      // If a table is currently open in inspector, update it without full-page reload
      if (selectedTableId) {
        fetch(`/counter-admin/get_table_orders/${selectedTableId}`)
          .then(r => r.text())
          .then(html => {
            const panel = document.getElementById('table-orders-panel');
            if (panel && String(panel.dataset.tableId) === String(selectedTableId)) {
              panel.innerHTML = html;
              attachPanelHandlers();
            }
          });
      }
    });

    // Search and Status Filters
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('counter-table-search');
    const filterBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.counter-filter-btn');
    let currentFilter = 'all';

    function filterTables() {
      const q = (searchInput.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
      document.querySelectorAll('.table-card').forEach(card => {
        const name = card.dataset.name || '';
        const status = card.dataset.status || '';
        const isAvail = status === 'available';
        const isBill = ['billing', 'bill_requested', 'pending_approval'].includes(status);
        const isOcc = !isAvail && !isBill;

        const matchesQuery = !q || name.includes(q);
        let matchesStatus = true;

        if (currentFilter === 'available') matchesStatus = isAvail;
        else if (currentFilter === 'occupied') matchesStatus = isOcc;
        else if (currentFilter === 'billing') matchesStatus = isBill;

        card.style.display = (matchesQuery && matchesStatus) ? 'flex' : 'none';
      });
    }

    searchInput.addEventListener('input', filterTables);
    filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        filterBtns.forEach(b => {
          b.style.background = '#fff';
          b.style.color = 'var(--ink-secondary)';
          b.style.borderColor = 'var(--line)';
        });
        btn.style.background = 'var(--brand)';
        btn.style.color = '#fff';
        btn.style.borderColor = 'var(--brand)';

        currentFilter = btn.dataset.filter;
        filterTables();
      });
    });

    // Initial check
    checkOnlineOrders();
  })();
</script>
</code>

<script>
  const tableId = <%= table.id %>;
  const slug = '<%= restaurant.slug %>';

  const selectAllCb = document.getElementById('select-all-checkbox');
  const itemCheckboxes = document.querySelectorAll('.bill-item-checkbox');
  const discountInput = document.getElementById('discount-percent');
  const taxInput = document.getElementById('tax-percent');
  const displaySubtotal = document.getElementById('display-subtotal');
  const displayDiscount = document.getElementById('display-discount');
  const displayTax = document.getElementById('display-tax');
  const displayGrandTotal = document.getElementById('display-grand-total');

  let currentSubtotal = 0;
  let currentGrandTotal = 0;

  function calculateTotals() {
    let sub = 0;
    itemCheckboxes.forEach(cb => {
      if (cb.checked) {
        sub += parseFloat(cb.dataset.price) * parseInt(cb.dataset.qty, 10);
      }
    });

    const discPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, parseFloat(discountInput.value) || 0));
    const taxPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, parseFloat(taxInput.value) || 0));

    const discAmt = (sub * discPct) / 100;
    const afterDisc = sub - discAmt;
    const taxAmt = (afterDisc * taxPct) / 100;
    const grand = afterDisc + taxAmt;

    currentSubtotal = sub;
    currentGrandTotal = grand;

    displaySubtotal.textContent = '$' + sub.toFixed(2);
    displayDiscount.textContent = '-$' + discAmt.toFixed(2);
    displayTax.textContent = '+$' + taxAmt.toFixed(2);
    displayGrandTotal.textContent = '$' + grand.toFixed(2);

    updateChange();
  }

  selectAllCb.addEventListener('change', () => {
    itemCheckboxes.forEach(cb => cb.checked = selectAllCb.checked);
    calculateTotals();
  });

  itemCheckboxes.forEach(cb => {
    cb.addEventListener('change', calculateTotals);
  });

  discountInput.addEventListener('input', calculateTotals);
  taxInput.addEventListener('input', calculateTotals);

  // Discount presets
  document.querySelectorAll('.discount-preset').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      discountInput.value = btn.dataset.pct;
      calculateTotals();
    });
  });

  // Tax presets
  document.querySelectorAll('.tax-preset').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      taxInput.value = btn.dataset.pct;
      calculateTotals();
    });
  });

  // Payment methods
  let selectedMethod = 'cash';
  const cashBox = document.getElementById('cash-tender-box');
  const tenderInput = document.getElementById('cash-tendered-input');
  const changeDueEl = document.getElementById('cash-change-due');

  document.querySelectorAll('.pay-method-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.pay-method-btn').forEach(b => {
        b.classList.remove('active-method');
        b.style.border = '1px solid var(--line)';
        b.style.background = '#fff';
        b.style.color = 'var(--ink-secondary)';
      });
      btn.classList.add('active-method');
      btn.style.border = '1.5px solid var(--brand)';
      btn.style.background = '#fff7ed';
      btn.style.color = '#9a3412';
      selectedMethod = btn.dataset.method;

      if (selectedMethod === 'cash') {
        cashBox.style.display = 'block';
      } else {
        cashBox.style.display = 'none';
      }
    });
  });

  function updateChange() {
    const tendered = parseFloat(tenderInput.value) || 0;
    const change = Math.max(0, tendered - currentGrandTotal);
    changeDueEl.textContent = '$' + change.toFixed(2);
  }

  tenderInput.addEventListener('input', updateChange);
  document.getElementById('tender-exact').addEventListener('click', () => {
    tenderInput.value = currentGrandTotal.toFixed(2);
    updateChange();
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.quick-tender[data-amt]').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      tenderInput.value = btn.dataset.amt;
      updateChange();
    });
  });

  // Settlement submission
  function submitSettlement(printReceipt) {
    const checked = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.bill-item-checkbox:checked')).map(cb => cb.value);
    if (!checked.length) {
      alert('Please select at least one item to bill.');
      return;
    }

    const payload = {
      item_ids: checked,
      discount_percent: discountInput.value,
      tax_percent: taxInput.value,
      print: printReceipt,
    };

    const submitBtn = printReceipt ? document.getElementById('print-and-complete-btn') : document.getElementById('complete-only-btn');
    submitBtn.disabled = true;
    submitBtn.textContent = 'Processing Settlement...';

    fetch(`/counter-admin/complete_order/${tableId}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    })
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(data => {
        if (data.error) {
          alert(data.error);
          submitBtn.disabled = false;
          return;
        }

        if (printReceipt && data.print_html) {
          const printWindow = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=380,height=600');
          if (printWindow) {
            printWindow.document.write(data.print_html);
            printWindow.document.close();
            printWindow.focus();
            setTimeout(() => {
              printWindow.print();
              printWindow.close();
              window.location = '/counter-admin/' + slug + '/counter';
            }, 500);
          } else {
            // If popup blocked, print via invisible iframe or redirect
            window.location = '/counter-admin/' + slug + '/counter';
          }
        } else {
          window.location = '/counter-admin/' + slug + '/counter';
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {
        submitBtn.disabled = false;
        alert('Network error while completing order.');
      });
  }

  document.getElementById('print-and-complete-btn').addEventListener('click', () => submitSettlement(true));
  document.getElementById('complete-only-btn').addEventListener('click', () => submitSettlement(false));

  calculateTotals();
</script>


</code>

<script>
  const netSales = <%= salesVal %>;
  const floatInput = document.getElementById('opening-float');
  const actualInput = document.getElementById('actual-cash');
  const dispOpening = document.getElementById('disp-opening');
  const expectedDrawer = document.getElementById('expected-drawer');
  const overShortDisplay = document.getElementById('over-short-display');
  const reconBox = document.getElementById('recon-status-box');

  function calculateReconciliation() {
    const floatVal = parseFloat(floatInput.value) || 0;
    const actualVal = parseFloat(actualInput.value) || 0;
    const expected = floatVal + netSales;
    const diff = actualVal - expected;

    dispOpening.textContent = '$' + floatVal.toFixed(2);
    expectedDrawer.textContent = '$' + expected.toFixed(2);

    if (Math.abs(diff) < 0.01) {
      overShortDisplay.textContent = 'Balanced ($0.00)';
      overShortDisplay.style.color = '#166534';
      reconBox.style.background = '#f0fdf4';
      reconBox.style.borderColor = '#bbf7d0';
    } else if (diff > 0) {
      overShortDisplay.textContent = 'Over by +$' + diff.toFixed(2);
      overShortDisplay.style.color = '#047857';
      reconBox.style.background = '#ecfdf5';
      reconBox.style.borderColor = '#a7f3d0';
    } else {
      overShortDisplay.textContent = 'Short by -$' + Math.abs(diff).toFixed(2);
      overShortDisplay.style.color = '#be123c';
      reconBox.style.background = '#fff1f2';
      reconBox.style.borderColor = '#fecdd3';
    }
  }

  floatInput.addEventListener('input', calculateReconciliation);
  actualInput.addEventListener('input', calculateReconciliation);
</script>

function getCallMeta(type) {
  switch(type) {
    case 'water':
      return { label: 'Water Refill', icon: '💧', bg: '#eff6ff', color: '#1e40af', border: '#bfdbfe' };
    case 'bill':
      return { label: 'Bill / Check', icon: '💳', bg: '#ecfdf5', color: '#065f46', border: '#a7f3d0' };
    case 'cutlery':
      return { label: 'Cutlery / Napkins', icon: '🍴', bg: '#fdf4ff', color: '#86198f', border: '#f5d0fe' };
    case 'clean':
      return { label: 'Table Cleaning', icon: '🧹', bg: '#fffbeb', color: '#92400e', border: '#fde68a' };
    default:
      return { label: 'General Assistance', icon: '🛎️', bg: '#fff7ed', color: '#9a3412', border: '#fed7aa' };
  }
}
%>

<script>
  (function() {
    const toast = document.getElementById('call-toast');
    const toastText = document.getElementById('toast-text');
    const toastIcon = document.getElementById('toast-icon');

    function showToast(msg, isError = false) {
      toastText.textContent = msg;
      toastIcon.textContent = isError ? '⚠️' : '✓';
      toast.style.background = isError ? '#991b1b' : '#065f46';
      toast.style.color = '#ffffff';
      toast.style.display = 'flex';
      setTimeout(() => { toast.style.display = 'none'; }, 3000);
    }

    // Audio Alert Synthesizer
    let soundEnabled = true;
    const soundBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-call-sound');
    const soundLabel = document.getElementById('call-sound-label');
    const soundIcon = document.getElementById('call-sound-icon');

    soundBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      soundEnabled = !soundEnabled;
      soundLabel.textContent = soundEnabled ? 'Audio: ON' : 'Audio: OFF';
      soundIcon.textContent = soundEnabled ? '🔔' : '🔕';
      if (soundEnabled) playBellChime();
    });

    function playBellChime() {
      if (!soundEnabled) return;
      try {
        const ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = ctx.createGain();
        osc.type = 'sine';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(880, ctx.currentTime); // A5
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(1174.66, ctx.currentTime + 0.12); // D6
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.25, ctx.currentTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.5);
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(ctx.destination);
        osc.start();
        osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.5);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // Elapsed timers
    function updateTimers() {
      document.querySelectorAll('.call-card').forEach(card => {
        const createdAt = Date.parse(card.dataset.createdAt);
        if (isNaN(createdAt)) return;
        const mins = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - createdAt) / 60000));
        const badge = card.querySelector('.call-elapsed');
        if (badge) badge.textContent = `Waiting ${mins}m`;
      });
    }
    updateTimers();
    setInterval(updateTimers, 15000);

    // In-place Resolve Button Click
    document.querySelectorAll('.resolve-call-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const id = btn.dataset.id;
        const table = btn.dataset.table;
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = 'Resolving...';

        try {
          const res = await fetch(`/staff-calls/${id}/resolve`, { method: 'POST' });
          const data = await res.json();
          if (res.ok && data.success) {
            const row = document.getElementById(`call-row-${id}`);
            if (row) {
              row.style.opacity = '0';
              row.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';
              setTimeout(() => {
                row.remove();
                updateBadgeCount();
              }, 250);
            }
            showToast(`Table ${table} call marked resolved!`);
          } else {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = '✓ Mark Done';
            alert(data.message || 'Could not resolve call.');
          }
        } catch (err) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.textContent = '✓ Mark Done';
        }
      });
    });

    function updateBadgeCount() {
      const remaining = document.querySelectorAll('.call-card').length;
      const badge = document.getElementById('pending-count-badge');
      const kpi = document.getElementById('kpi-pending-count');
      if (badge) badge.textContent = `${remaining} Active Call${remaining === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
      if (kpi) kpi.textContent = remaining;

      if (remaining === 0) {
        const container = document.getElementById('call-items-container');
        if (container) {
          container.innerHTML = `
            <div id="no-calls-empty" style="text-align:center;padding:56px 16px;">
              <div style="font-size:42px;margin-bottom:10px;">🛎️</div>
              <h3 style="margin:0 0 6px;color:var(--ink);">All tables attended</h3>
              <p style="color:var(--muted);margin:0;font-size:13.5px;">There are no pending assistance calls.</p>
            </div>`;
        }
      }
    }

    // Toggle Resolved Log
    const toggleHistoryBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-view-history-btn');
    const historySection = document.getElementById('resolved-calls-section');
    toggleHistoryBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const isOpen = historySection.style.display !== 'none';
      historySection.style.display = isOpen ? 'none' : 'block';
      toggleHistoryBtn.textContent = isOpen ? '📜 View Resolved Log' : '✕ Hide Resolved Log';
    });

    // Clear Resolved Log
    const clearBtn = document.getElementById('btn-clear-resolved');
    if (clearBtn) {
      clearBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        if (!confirm('Clear all resolved logs for today?')) return;
        await fetch('/staff-calls/clear-resolved', { method: 'POST' });
        historySection.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:var(--muted);padding:16px;">Log cleared.</p>';
      });
    }

    // Filter Chips
    document.querySelectorAll('.call-filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.call-filter-btn').forEach(b => {
          b.style.background = '#fff';
          b.style.color = 'var(--ink-secondary)';
          b.style.borderColor = 'var(--line)';
        });
        btn.style.background = 'var(--brand)';
        btn.style.color = '#fff';
        btn.style.borderColor = 'var(--brand)';

        const f = btn.dataset.filter;
        document.querySelectorAll('.call-card').forEach(card => {
          card.style.display = (f === 'all' || card.dataset.type === f) ? 'flex' : 'none';
        });
      });
    });

    // Socket.IO Real-time Connection
    const socket = io();
    socket.emit('join-restaurant', <%= currentUser.id %>);
    socket.on('restaurant-update', (event) => {
      if (event.reason === 'staff-call') {
        playBellChime();
        showToast(`🛎️ New call from Table ${event.tableName || ''}!`);
        setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 600);
      } else if (event.reason === 'staff-call-updated') {
        setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 600);
      }
    });

  })();
</script>

<%
function statusLabel(status) {
  if (status === 'preparing') return 'Cooking';
  if (status === 'order_delivered') return 'Ready';
  if (status === 'cancelled') return 'Cancelled';
  return 'Pending';
}

const isBar = station === 'bar';
const updateBaseUrl = isBar ? '/kitchen-admin' : '/kitchen-admin/kitchen';
const categories = [...new Set(activeOrders.map((o) => o.item && o.item.category ? o.item.category.category_name : 'Uncategorized'))].sort();
const pendingOrders = activeOrders.filter(o => ['order_food', 'order_drink', 'approved', 'confirmed'].includes(o.status));
const cookingOrders = activeOrders.filter(o => o.status === 'preparing');

// Group tickets by table for Table-Wise tab
const ticketsByTable = {};
activeOrders.forEach(o => {
  const tblName = o.table ? o.table.table_name : 'Walk-In';
  if (!ticketsByTable[tblName]) ticketsByTable[tblName] = [];
  ticketsByTable[tblName].push(o);
});

// Consolidate batch totals for Expo / Prep summary tab
const itemTotals = {};
activeOrders.forEach(o => {
  const name = o.item ? o.item.item_name : ('Item #' + o.item_id);
  const key = o.item_id + (o.variant ? ('-' + o.variant.name) : '');
  if (!itemTotals[key]) {
    itemTotals[key] = {
      id: o.item_id,
      name,
      variant: o.variant ? o.variant.name : null,
      category: o.item && o.item.category ? o.item.category.category_name : 'General',
      sold_out: o.item ? o.item.sold_out : false,
      totalQty: 0,
      tables: [],
      orderIds: []
    };
  }
  itemTotals[key].totalQty += o.quantity;
  itemTotals[key].orderIds.push(`${o._model}:${o.id}`);
  const tbl = o.table ? o.table.table_name : 'Takeaway';
  if (!itemTotals[key].tables.includes(tbl)) itemTotals[key].tables.push(tbl);
});

                <span class="badge" style="background:#0f172a;color:#38bdf8;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:4px;"><%= bi.category %></span>
                <strong style="display:block;font-size:17px;color:#f8fafc;line-height:1.2;"><%= bi.name %></strong>
                <% if (bi.variant) { %><span style="font-size:12.5px;color:#94a3b8;">(<%= bi.variant %>)</span><% } %>
              </div>
              <span class="badge" style="background:var(--brand);color:#ffffff;font-size:20px;font-weight:900;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:8px;">
                <%= bi.totalQty %>

              Needed for: <strong style="color:#f8fafc;"><%= bi.tables.join(', ') %></strong>

              ✓ Mark Ready (<%= bi.totalQty %>)
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary toggle-86-btn" data-item-id="<%= bi.id %>" data-item-name="<%= bi.name %>" style="padding:8px 10px;font-size:11.5px;background:#334155;color:#f8fafc;border-color:#475569;">

<script src="/socket.io/socket.io.js"></script>
<script>
  (function() {
    const restaurantId = <%= restaurantId %>;
    const updateBaseUrl = '<%= updateBaseUrl %>';
    const tickets = [...document.querySelectorAll('.ticket')];
    const toast = document.getElementById('kds-toast');
    const toastText = document.getElementById('toast-text');
    const toastIcon = document.getElementById('toast-icon');

    // Toast Alert Notification Helper
    function showToast(message, isError = false) {
      toastText.textContent = message;
      toastIcon.textContent = isError ? '⚠️' : '✓';
      toast.style.background = isError ? '#991b1b' : '#065f46';
      toast.style.color = '#ffffff';
      toast.style.display = 'flex';
      setTimeout(() => { toast.style.display = 'none'; }, 2800);
    }

    // Web Audio Synthesizer for Kitchen Chime
    let soundEnabled = true;
    const soundBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-sound-btn');
    soundBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      soundEnabled = !soundEnabled;
      soundBtn.textContent = soundEnabled ? '🔔 Audio: ON' : '🔕 Audio: OFF';
      if (soundEnabled) playChime();
    });

    function playChime() {
      if (!soundEnabled) return;
      try {
        const ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = ctx.createGain();
        osc.type = 'sine';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(587.33, ctx.currentTime); // D5
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(880, ctx.currentTime + 0.14); // A5
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.25, ctx.currentTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.45);
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(ctx.destination);
        osc.start();
        osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.45);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // Fullscreen Monitor Toggle
    const fullBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-fullscreen-btn');
    fullBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
        document.documentElement.requestFullscreen().catch(() => {});
        document.body.classList.add('kds-fullscreen');
        fullBtn.textContent = '✕ Exit Fullscreen';
      } else {
        document.exitFullscreen().catch(() => {});
        document.body.classList.remove('kds-fullscreen');
        fullBtn.textContent = '⛶ Fullscreen';
      }
    });

    // Dynamic Elapsed Timer & Urgency Colors
    function updateElapsed(ticket) {
      const createdAt = Date.parse(ticket.dataset.createdAt);
      if (isNaN(createdAt)) return;
      const minutes = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - createdAt) / 60000));
      const badge = ticket.querySelector('[data-elapsed]');
      if (badge) badge.textContent = `${minutes}m`;

      ticket.classList.toggle('urgent-warn', minutes >= 5 && minutes < 12);
      ticket.classList.toggle('urgent-danger', minutes >= 12);
    }

    tickets.forEach(updateElapsed);
    setInterval(() => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.ticket').forEach(updateElapsed);
    }, 10000);

    // Tab Switching
    document.querySelectorAll('.kds-tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.kds-tab-btn').forEach(b => {
          b.classList.remove('active-tab');
          b.style.background = '#1e293b';
          b.style.color = '#f8fafc';
          b.style.borderColor = '#334155';
        });
        btn.classList.add('active-tab');
        btn.style.background = 'var(--brand)';
        btn.style.color = '#ffffff';
        btn.style.borderColor = 'var(--brand)';

        const targetTabId = btn.dataset.tab;
        document.querySelectorAll('.kds-tab-content').forEach(content => {
          content.style.display = content.id === targetTabId ? 'block' : 'none';
        });
      });
    });

    // Category Filter
    const catSelect = document.getElementById('station-category');
    if (catSelect) {
      catSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const val = catSelect.value;
        document.querySelectorAll('.ticket').forEach(ticket => {
          ticket.style.display = (val === 'all' || ticket.dataset.category === val) ? 'flex' : 'none';
        });
      });
    }

    // In-Place Ticket Bumping (Advance Cooking -> Ready)
    document.querySelectorAll('.advance-ticket-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
          const id = btn.dataset.id;
        const source = btn.dataset.source;
        const action = btn.dataset.action;
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = 'Updating...';

        try {
          const res = await fetch(`${updateBaseUrl}/update-order/${id}?action=${action}&source=${source}`);
          const data = await res.json();
          if (res.ok && data.success) {
            const ticket = document.getElementById(`ticket-${source}-${id}`);
            if (action === 'order_delivered') {
              // Smooth bump animation and removal
              showToast('Ticket bumped & marked ready!');
              if (ticket) {
                ticket.style.transform = 'scale(0.9)';
                ticket.style.opacity = '0';
                setTimeout(() => { ticket.remove(); updateMetrics(); }, 250);
              }
            } else if (action === 'preparing') {
              showToast('Cooking started!');
              if (ticket) {
                ticket.classList.add('ticket-cooking');
                const statusPill = ticket.querySelector('.status-pill');
                if (statusPill) {
                  statusPill.textContent = '● Cooking';
                  statusPill.style.background = '#ea580c';
                }
                btn.dataset.action = 'order_delivered';
                btn.textContent = '✓ Mark Ready & Serve';
                btn.style.background = '#16a34a';
                btn.style.borderColor = '#16a34a';
                btn.disabled = false;
                updateMetrics();
              }
            }
          } else {
            btn.disabled = false;
            alert(data.message || 'Error updating ticket.');
          }
        } catch (e) {
          btn.disabled = false;
        }
      });
    });

    // Cancel Ticket Button
    document.querySelectorAll('.cancel-ticket-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        if (!confirm('Cancel this kitchen order item?')) return;
        const id = btn.dataset.id;
        const source = btn.dataset.source;
        btn.disabled = true;

        try {
          const res = await fetch(`${updateBaseUrl}/update-order/${id}?action=cancelled&source=${source}`);
          if (res.ok) {
            const ticket = document.getElementById(`ticket-${source}-${id}`);
            if (ticket) {
              ticket.style.opacity = '0';
              setTimeout(() => { ticket.remove(); updateMetrics(); }, 250);
            }
            showToast('Item cancelled');
          }
        } catch (e) {
          btn.disabled = false;
        }
      });
    });

    // Batch Mark Ready (Expo and Table tabs)
    document.querySelectorAll('.batch-mark-ready-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const refs = btn.dataset.ids.split(',').map(ref => {
          const [source, id] = ref.split(':');
          return { source, id };
        });
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = 'Updating...';

        try {
          const responses = await Promise.all(refs.map(({ source, id }) =>
            fetch(`${updateBaseUrl}/update-order/${id}?action=order_delivered&source=${source}`)
          ));
          if (responses.some(response => !response.ok)) throw new Error('Some tickets could not be updated.');
          showToast('Batch items marked ready!');
          setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 400);
        } catch (e) {
          btn.disabled = false;
        }
      });
    });

    // "Start All Cooking" shortcut
    const startAllBtn = document.getElementById('start-all-cooking-btn');
    if (startAllBtn) {
      startAllBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        startAllBtn.disabled = true;
        const pendingBtns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.advance-ticket-btn')).filter(b => b.dataset.action === 'preparing');
        if (!pendingBtns.length) {
          showToast('No pending items to start.');
          startAllBtn.disabled = false;
          return;
        }
        startAllBtn.textContent = 'Starting all...';
        await Promise.all(pendingBtns.map(b => fetch(`${updateBaseUrl}/update-order/${b.dataset.id}?action=preparing&source=${b.dataset.source}`)));
        showToast('All items are now cooking!');
        setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 400);
      });
    }

    // Instant 86 / Sold-Out Toggle
    document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-86-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const itemId = btn.dataset.itemId;
        const name = btn.dataset.itemName;
        btn.disabled = true;

        try {
          const res = await fetch(`${updateBaseUrl}/toggle-sold-out/${itemId}`, { method: 'POST' });
          const data = await res.json();
          btn.disabled = false;
          if (res.ok && data.success) {
            btn.textContent = data.sold_out ? 'Back in stock' : '86 Item';
            btn.style.background = data.sold_out ? '#16a34a' : '#be123c';
            showToast(data.sold_out ? `"${name}" is now marked 86'd!` : `"${name}" is back in stock!`);
          }
        } catch (e) {
          btn.disabled = false;
        }
      });
    });

    function updateMetrics() {
      const allTickets = document.querySelectorAll('.ticket');
      const cooking = document.querySelectorAll('.ticket.ticket-cooking').length;
      const pending = allTickets.length - cooking;
      const pendingEl = document.getElementById('kds-pending-count');
      const cookingEl = document.getElementById('kds-cooking-count');
      if (pendingEl) pendingEl.textContent = pending;
      if (cookingEl) cookingEl.textContent = cooking;
    }

    // Real-Time Socket Connection
    const socket = io();
    socket.emit('join-restaurant', restaurantId);

    socket.on('restaurant-update', (event) => {
      playChime();
      showToast('New ticket activity on station!');
      setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 600);
    });

  })();
</script>

</code>

<code>
<div class="card">
  <h2>Edit setting</h2>
  <form method="POST" action="/superadmin/setting/<%= setting.id %>">
    <label>Name</label>
    <input type="text" name="option_name" value="<%= setting.option_name %>">
    <label>Value</label>

src\app.js:
<code>
const express = require('express');
const session = require('express-session');
const cookieParser = require('cookie-parser');
const expressLayouts = require('express-ejs-layouts');
const path = require('path');

const { User, Branch } = require('./models');
const { loadCurrentUser } = require('./middleware/auth');
const { loadTenantContext } = require('./middleware/tenant');
const webRoutes = require('./routes/web');

// Builds and returns a configured Express app, but does NOT connect to the
// database, initialize Socket.IO, or start listening - server.js does all
// three of those around this. Tests import this module directly and drive
// it with supertest, which doesn't need a real listening port.
function createApp() {
  const app = express();

  app.set('view engine', 'ejs');
  app.set('views', path.join(__dirname, 'views'));
  app.use(expressLayouts);
  app.set('layout', 'layout');

  app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true }));
  app.use(express.json());
  app.use(cookieParser());
  app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, '..', 'public')));

  app.use(
    session({
      secret: process.env.SESSION_SECRET || 'change-me',
      resave: false,
      saveUninitialized: false,
      cookie: {
        maxAge: 120 * 60 * 1000, // matches SESSION_LIFETIME=120 (minutes) in the old .env
        secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
      },
      // NOTE: default MemoryStore is dev-only and leaks memory / won't scale
      // past one process. Swap in connect-session-sequelize (backed by the
      // same DB) or connect-redis before deploying, the way Laravel's
      // SESSION_DRIVER=file/redis config would.
    })
  );

  app.use(loadCurrentUser(User));
  app.use(loadTenantContext(Branch));
  app.use((req, res, next) => {
    res.locals.currentPath = req.path;
    next();
  });

  app.use('/', webRoutes);

  app.use((req, res) => {
    res.status(404).send('Not found');
  });

  // eslint-disable-next-line no-unused-vars
  app.use((err, req, res, next) => {
    console.error(err);
    res.status(500).send('Internal server error');
  });

  return app;
}

module.exports = createApp;

</code>

tests\helpers\setup.js:
<code>
// Shared test setup: rebuilds the schema from sql/schema.sql against
// whatever DB the environment's .env/.env.test points at, then exposes
// helpers to seed a baseline restaurant/table/category/item fixture and
// to build a fresh (unlistened) app instance for supertest.
//
// Requires a real MySQL/MariaDB reachable with the configured
// credentials - these are integration tests against a real database, the
// same way every round of manual testing in this project was done, not
// mocked-model unit tests.

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
require('dotenv').config({ path: path.join(__dirname, '..', '..', '.env.test') });

const { sequelize } = require('../../src/models');
const createApp = require('../../src/app');
const bcrypt = require('bcryptjs');

async function resetDatabase() {
  const schemaSql = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, '..', '..', 'sql', 'schema.sql'), 'utf8');

  // Drop everything first (in FK-safe order - reverse of creation order,
  // roughly) so re-running this between test files always starts clean,
  // not just "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS" over old rows.
  await sequelize.query('SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS = 0');
  const tableNames = [...schemaSql.matchAll(/CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS (\w+)/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
  for (const table of tableNames) {
    await sequelize.query(`DROP TABLE IF EXISTS \`${table}\``);
  }
  await sequelize.query('SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS = 1');

  const statements = schemaSql.split(';').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  for (const statement of statements) {
    await sequelize.query(statement);
  }
}

// Seeds one restaurant owner + one table + one category + one item -
// the same minimal fixture used by hand in every manual test round.
async function seedBaseline() {
  const { User, Branch, RestaurantTable, Category, Item } = require('../../src/models');

  const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash('password123', 10);
  const restaurant = await User.create({
    name: 'Demo Restaurant',
    slug: 'demo-restaurant',
    email: 'owner@example.com',
    password: passwordHash,
    status: 'approved',
    user_type: 'R',
    pay_first: false,
  });

  const branch = await Branch.create({ restaurant_id: restaurant.id, name: 'Main Branch', slug: 'main', is_active: true });

  const table = await RestaurantTable.create({
    restaurant_id: restaurant.id,
    branch_id: branch.id,
    table_name: 'Table 1',
    table_slug: 'table-1',
    status: 'available',
  });

  const category = await Category.create({
    user_id: restaurant.id,
    branch_id: branch.id,
    category_name: 'Starters',
    category_order: 1,
  });

  const item = await Item.create({
    user_id: restaurant.id,
    branch_id: branch.id,
    item_name: 'Spring Rolls',
    item_slug: 'spring-rolls',
    item_category: category.id,
    price: 10.0,
    item_order: 1,
  });

  return { restaurant, branch, table, category, item };
}

function getApp() {
  return createApp();
}

async function closeAll() {
  await sequelize.close();
}

module.exports = { resetDatabase, seedBaseline, getApp, closeAll, sequelize };

</code>

test('guest delivery/pickup checkout creates a requested Order the counter can approve', async () => {
  const { Order, RestaurantTable } = require('../src/models');
  const guest = request.agent(app);

  const menuRes = await guest.get(`/${fixture.restaurant.slug}/menu`);
  assert.equal(menuRes.status, 200);

  const addRes = await guest
    .post('/add-to-cart')
    .send({ items: [{ item_id: fixture.item.id, quantity: 3, comment: 'extra sauce' }] });
  assert.equal(addRes.status, 200);
  assert.equal(addRes.body.totalItem, 1);

  const checkoutPage = await guest.get('/checkout');
  assert.equal(checkoutPage.status, 200);
  assert.match(checkoutPage.text, /Checkout/);

  const orderRes = await guest.post('/store_order').type('form').send({
    name: 'Jane Guest',
    email: 'jane@example.com',
    phone: '555-1234',
    delivery_type: 'pickup',
    total_cost: 30,
    delivery_charge: 0,
  });
  assert.equal(orderRes.status, 302);
  assert.match(orderRes.headers.location, /^\/order\/\d+$/);

  const order = await Order.findOne({ where: { name: 'Jane Guest' } });
  assert.ok(order);
  assert.equal(order.order_status, 'requested');
  assert.equal(order.qr_type, 'Order Online QR');

  const orderPage = await guest.get(`/order/${order.id}`);
  assert.equal(orderPage.status, 200);
  assert.match(orderPage.text, /Jane Guest/);

  // Owner approves it from the counter's pending-online-orders panel -
  // should create a virtual table and route the item to the kitchen.
  const owner = request.agent(app);
  await owner.post('/login').type('form').send({ email: 'owner@example.com', password: 'password123' });

  const pendingRes = await owner.get(`/counter-admin/get-online-orders/${fixture.restaurant.id}`);
  assert.equal(pendingRes.status, 200);
  assert.equal(pendingRes.body.count, 1);

  const approveRes = await owner.post(`/counter-admin/approve-order/${order.id}`);
  assert.equal(approveRes.status, 200);
  assert.equal(approveRes.body.success, true);

  const updatedOrder = await Order.findByPk(order.id);
  assert.equal(updatedOrder.order_status, 'approved');
  assert.ok(updatedOrder.table_id, 'expected a virtual table to have been created and linked');

  const virtualTable = await RestaurantTable.findByPk(updatedOrder.table_id);
  assert.equal(virtualTable.is_virtual, true);
});

test('inventory stock-in/stock-out math is correct and over-withdrawal is rejected', async () => {
  const { InventoryItem } = require('../src/models');

  const createRes = await owner.post('/inventory').type('form').send({ name: 'Rice', unit: 'kg', quantity: 100, price_per_unit: 1.2 });
  assert.equal(createRes.status, 302);

  const item = await InventoryItem.findOne({ where: { name: 'Rice' } });
  assert.equal(Number(item.quantity), 100);

  await owner.post(`/inventory/${item.id}/stock-in`).type('form').send({ quantity: 50, notes: 'Delivery' });
  await owner.post(`/inventory/${item.id}/stock-out`).type('form').send({ quantity: 30, notes: 'Used in kitchen' });

  const afterMoves = await InventoryItem.findByPk(item.id);
  assert.equal(Number(afterMoves.quantity), 120); // 100 + 50 - 30

  const overWithdraw = await owner.post(`/inventory/${item.id}/stock-out`).type('form').send({ quantity: 99999, notes: 'too much' });
  assert.equal(overWithdraw.status, 422);
  assert.match(overWithdraw.text, /cannot exceed/);

  const unchanged = await InventoryItem.findByPk(item.id);
  assert.equal(Number(unchanged.quantity), 120); // rejected withdrawal must not have applied
});

test('order-summary and per-item order reports split online vs. table orders correctly', async () => {
  const { Category, Item, Order, OrderItem } = require('../src/models');

  const drinksCategory = await Category.create({ user_id: fixture.restaurant.id, category_name: 'Drinks', category_order: 2 });
  const icedTea = await Item.create({
    user_id: fixture.restaurant.id,
    item_name: 'Iced Tea',
    item_slug: 'iced-tea',
    item_category: drinksCategory.id,
    price: 3.0,
    item_order: 1,
  });

  const onlineOrder = await Order.create({ res_id: fixture.restaurant.id, name: 'Order A', total_cost: 23, order_status: 'completed', qr_type: 'Order Online QR' });
  await OrderItem.create({ order_id: onlineOrder.id, item_id: fixture.item.id, price: 10, qty: 2, total: 20 });
  await OrderItem.create({ order_id: onlineOrder.id, item_id: icedTea.id, price: 3, qty: 1, total: 3 });

  const tableOrder = await Order.create({ res_id: fixture.restaurant.id, name: 'Order B', total_cost: 6, order_status: 'completed', qr_type: 'Table Based QR' });
  await OrderItem.create({ order_id: tableOrder.id, item_id: icedTea.id, price: 3, qty: 2, total: 6 });

  const summaryRes = await owner.get('/order-summary');
  assert.equal(summaryRes.status, 200);
  assert.match(summaryRes.text, />2<\/strong>/); // total order count
  assert.match(summaryRes.text, />29\.00<\/strong>/); // total sales

  const onlineReportRes = await owner.get('/order-report');
  assert.equal(onlineReportRes.status, 200);
  assert.match(onlineReportRes.text, /Spring Rolls/);
  assert.match(onlineReportRes.text, /2 sold/);

  const tableReportRes = await owner.get('/table-order-by-items');
  assert.equal(tableReportRes.status, 200);
  assert.match(tableReportRes.text, /Iced Tea/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(tableReportRes.text, /Spring Rolls/); // Spring Rolls was only in the online order
});

tests\ordering.test.js:

const { test, before, after } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const request = require('supertest');
const { resetDatabase, seedBaseline, getApp, closeAll } = require('./helpers/setup');

let app;
let fixture;

before(async () => {
  await resetDatabase();
  fixture = await seedBaseline();
  app = getApp();
});

after(async () => {
  await closeAll();
});

test('full dine-in order lifecycle: menu -> cart -> confirm -> kitchen -> billed', async () => {
  const { sequelize, TableCustomer, RestaurantTable, Order, OrderItem } = require('../src/models');
  const guest = request.agent(app);

  // 1. Load the table menu - this auto-occupies the table and starts a session.
  const menuRes = await guest.get(`/${fixture.restaurant.slug}/menu/${fixture.table.table_slug}`);
  assert.equal(menuRes.status, 200);
  assert.match(menuRes.text, /Spring Rolls/);
  assert.ok(menuRes.headers['set-cookie']?.some((cookie) => cookie.startsWith('connect.sid=')));

  const occupiedTable = await RestaurantTable.findByPk(fixture.table.id);
  assert.equal(occupiedTable.status, 'occupied');

  // 2. Add 2x Spring Rolls to the cart.
  const addRes = await guest
    .post('/add-table-menu')
    .send({ table_id: fixture.table.id, items: [{ item_id: fixture.item.id, quantity: 2 }] });
  assert.equal(addRes.status, 200);
  assert.equal(addRes.body.success, 'Items added to cart successfully.');

  const cartRows = await TableCustomer.findAll({ where: { table_id: fixture.table.id, status: 'add_to_cart' } });
  assert.equal(cartRows.length, 1);
  assert.equal(cartRows[0].quantity, 2);
  assert.equal(Number(cartRows[0].price), 10);

  // 3. Confirm the order - should flip status to confirmed, then to order_food
  // (not a drink) since sendToKitchen() runs for a non-pay-first restaurant.
  const confirmRes = await guest.post('/tablecart/store').send({ table_id: fixture.table.id });
  assert.equal(confirmRes.status, 200);
  assert.equal(confirmRes.body.success, true);

  const confirmedRow = await TableCustomer.findOne({ where: { table_id: fixture.table.id } });
  assert.equal(confirmedRow.status, 'order_food');

  // 4. Owner logs in and moves the item through the kitchen board.
  const owner = request.agent(app);
  await owner.post('/login').type('form').send({ email: 'owner@example.com', password: 'password123' });

  const prepRes = await owner.get(`/kitchen-admin/kitchen/update-order/${confirmedRow.id}?action=preparing`);
  assert.equal(prepRes.status, 200);
  const deliveredRes = await owner.get(`/kitchen-admin/kitchen/update-order/${confirmedRow.id}?action=order_delivered`);
  assert.equal(deliveredRes.status, 200);

  const deliveredRow = await TableCustomer.findByPk(confirmedRow.id);
  assert.equal(deliveredRow.status, 'order_delivered');

  // 5. Counter completes the order for this table - should create a real
  // Order + OrderItem, and reset the table back to available.
  const completeRes = await owner
    .post(`/counter-admin/complete_order/${fixture.table.id}`)
    .send({ item_ids: [String(deliveredRow.id)], discount_percent: 0, tax_percent: 0 });
  assert.equal(completeRes.status, 200);
  assert.equal(completeRes.body.success, 'Order completed successfully.');

  const order = await Order.findOne({ where: { table_id: fixture.table.id } });
  assert.ok(order, 'expected an Order row to have been created');
  assert.equal(Number(order.total_cost), 20); // 2 x $10

  const orderItem = await OrderItem.findOne({ where: { order_id: order.id } });
  assert.equal(orderItem.qty, 2);
  assert.equal(Number(orderItem.total), 20);

  const finalTable = await RestaurantTable.findByPk(fixture.table.id);
  assert.equal(finalTable.status, 'available');
  assert.equal(finalTable.table_token, null);

  const remainingCartRows = await TableCustomer.count({ where: { table_id: fixture.table.id } });
  assert.equal(remainingCartRows, 0);
});

</code>

test('a discount reduces both the displayed price and the actual cart price, rounded to the nearest $5', async () => {
  const { Item } = require('../src/models');
  await Item.update({ price: 20.0 }, { where: { id: fixture.item.id } });

  const createRes = await owner.post('/discounts').type('form').send({
    start_time: '00:00',
    end_time: '23:59',
    discount_percentage: 25,
    days: ['Sunday', 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday'],
    item_ids: [String(fixture.item.id)],
  });
  assert.equal(createRes.status, 302);

  // $20 at 25% off = $15, which is already a multiple of 5, so the
  // "round to nearest $5" rule doesn't obscure this test case.
  const menuRes = await request(app).get(`/${fixture.restaurant.slug}/menu/${fixture.table.table_slug}`);
  assert.equal(menuRes.status, 200);
  assert.match(menuRes.text, /\$15\.00/);
  assert.match(menuRes.text, /25(\.00)?% off now/);

  const guest = request.agent(app);
  await guest.get(`/${fixture.restaurant.slug}/menu/${fixture.table.table_slug}`);
  await guest.post('/add-table-menu').send({ table_id: fixture.table.id, items: [{ item_id: fixture.item.id, quantity: 1 }] });

  const { TableCustomer } = require('../src/models');
  const cartRow = await TableCustomer.findOne({ where: { table_id: fixture.table.id } });
  assert.equal(Number(cartRow.price), 15);
});

test('a promotion is hidden behind an inactive subscription and shown once one is active', async () => {
  const { UserSubscription, Subscription } = require('../src/models');

  const inactiveRes = await request(app).get(`/${fixture.restaurant.slug}/offer`);
  assert.equal(inactiveRes.status, 200);
  assert.match(inactiveRes.text, /subscription is currently inactive/);

  const createRes = await owner.post('/promotions').type('form').send({
    name: 'Happy Hour',
    start_date: '2026-01-01',
    end_date: '2026-12-31',
    is_active: 'Active',
    days: ['All Day'],
    item_ids: [String(fixture.item.id)],
    [`offer_price_${fixture.item.id}`]: '6.50',
  });
  assert.equal(createRes.status, 302);

  const plan = await Subscription.create({ name: 'Pro', month: 1, cost: '29.99' });
  await UserSubscription.create({
    user_id: fixture.restaurant.id,
    subscription_id: plan.id,
    payment_status: 'paid',
    subscription_status: 'active',
    subscription_start_date: '2026-01-01',
    subscription_end_date: '2026-12-31',
  });

  const activeRes = await request(app).get(`/${fixture.restaurant.slug}/offer`);
  assert.equal(activeRes.status, 200);
  assert.match(activeRes.text, /Happy Hour/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(activeRes.text, /subscription is currently inactive/);

tests\reservation.test.js:
<code>
const { test, before, after } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const request = require('supertest');
const { resetDatabase, seedBaseline, getApp, closeAll } = require('./helpers/setup');

let app;
let fixture;
let owner;

before(async () => {
  await resetDatabase();
  fixture = await seedBaseline();
  app = getApp();
  owner = request.agent(app);
  await owner.post('/login').type('form').send({ email: 'owner@example.com', password: 'password123' });
});

after(async () => closeAll());

test('owner can create and update a reservation', async () => {
  const starts = new Date(Date.now() + 86400000);
  const ends = new Date(starts.getTime() + 90 * 60000);
  const response = await owner.post('/reservations').type('form').send({
    customer_name: 'Asha Guest',
    customer_phone: '555-0100',
    guest_count: 3,
    table_id: fixture.table.id,
    starts_at: starts.toISOString().slice(0, 16),
    ends_at: ends.toISOString().slice(0, 16),
  });
  assert.equal(response.status, 302);

  const { Reservation } = require('../src/models');
  const reservation = await Reservation.findOne({ where: { customer_name: 'Asha Guest' } });
  assert.ok(reservation);
  assert.equal(reservation.branch_id, fixture.branch.id);

  const status = await owner.post(`/reservations/${reservation.id}/status`).type('form').send({ status: 'confirmed' });
  assert.equal(status.status, 200);
  assert.equal((await reservation.reload()).status, 'confirmed');
});

test('overlapping reservations on one table are rejected', async () => {
  const starts = new Date(Date.now() + 172800000);
  const ends = new Date(starts.getTime() + 90 * 60000);
  const payload = { customer_name: 'First Guest', guest_count: 2, table_id: fixture.table.id, starts_at: starts.toISOString().slice(0, 16), ends_at: ends.toISOString().slice(0, 16) };
  assert.equal((await owner.post('/reservations').type('form').send(payload)).status, 302);
  assert.equal((await owner.post('/reservations').type('form').send({ ...payload, customer_name: 'Second Guest' })).status, 422);
});

</code>

tests\superadmin.test.js:
<code>
const { test, before, after } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const request = require('supertest');
const bcrypt = require('bcryptjs');
const { resetDatabase, seedBaseline, getApp, closeAll } = require('./helpers/setup');

let app;
let fixture;

before(async () => {
  await resetDatabase();
  fixture = await seedBaseline();
  app = getApp();

  const { User } = require('../src/models');
  await User.create({
    name: 'Platform Admin',
    slug: 'admin',
    email: 'admin@example.com',
    password: await bcrypt.hash('password123', 10),
    status: 'approved',
    user_type: 'S',
  });
});

after(async () => {
  await closeAll();
});

test('a restaurant owner cannot access /superadmin routes', async () => {
  const owner = request.agent(app);
  await owner.post('/login').type('form').send({ email: 'owner@example.com', password: 'password123' });
  const res = await owner.get('/superadmin/dashboard');
  assert.equal(res.status, 401);
});

test('platform admin logs in, sees a pending restaurant, and can approve it', async () => {
  const { User } = require('../src/models');
  await User.create({
    name: 'New Restaurant',
    slug: 'new-restaurant',
    email: 'newres@example.com',
    password: await bcrypt.hash('password123', 10),
    status: 'pending',
    user_type: 'R',
  });

  const admin = request.agent(app);
  const loginRes = await admin.post('/login').type('form').send({ email: 'admin@example.com', password: 'password123' });
  assert.equal(loginRes.status, 302);
  assert.equal(loginRes.headers.location, '/superadmin/dashboard');

  const listRes = await admin.get('/superadmin/restaurants');
  assert.equal(listRes.status, 200);
  assert.match(listRes.text, /New Restaurant/);

  const newRestaurant = await User.findOne({ where: { email: 'newres@example.com' } });
  const approveRes = await admin.post('/superadmin/restaurant-change-status').type('form').send({ res_id: newRestaurant.id, status: 'approved' });
  assert.equal(approveRes.status, 302);

  const updated = await User.findByPk(newRestaurant.id);
  assert.equal(updated.status, 'approved');
});

</code>

tests\tenantIsolation.test.js:
<code>
const { test, before, after } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const request = require('supertest');
const bcrypt = require('bcryptjs');
const { resetDatabase, seedBaseline, getApp, closeAll } = require('./helpers/setup');

let app;
let fixture;
let owner;
let otherRestaurant;
let otherItem;
let otherTable;

before(async () => {
  await resetDatabase();
  fixture = await seedBaseline();
  const { User, Branch, Category, Item, RestaurantTable } = require('../src/models');
  otherRestaurant = await User.create({
    name: 'Other Restaurant',
    slug: 'other-restaurant',
    email: 'other.owner@example.com',
    password: await bcrypt.hash('password123', 10),
    user_type: 'R',
    status: 'approved',
  });
  const otherBranch = await Branch.create({ restaurant_id: otherRestaurant.id, name: 'Other Main', slug: 'main', is_active: true });
  const otherCategory = await Category.create({ user_id: otherRestaurant.id, branch_id: otherBranch.id, category_name: 'Other Menu' });
  otherItem = await Item.create({
    user_id: otherRestaurant.id,
    branch_id: otherBranch.id,
    item_name: 'Other Item',
    item_slug: 'other-item',
    item_category: otherCategory.id,
    price: 12,
  });
  otherTable = await RestaurantTable.create({
    restaurant_id: otherRestaurant.id,
    branch_id: otherBranch.id,
    table_name: 'Other Table',
    table_slug: 'other-table',
    status: 'available',
  });

  app = getApp();
  owner = request.agent(app);
  await owner.post('/login').type('form').send({ email: 'owner@example.com', password: 'password123' });
});

after(async () => {
  await closeAll();
});

test('owner cannot read or mutate another restaurant menu and table records', async () => {
  const menuPage = await owner.get(`/menus/${otherItem.id}/edit`);
  assert.equal(menuPage.status, 404);

  const toggle = await owner.post(`/menus/${otherItem.id}/toggle-sold-out`).set('Accept', 'application/json');
  assert.equal(toggle.status, 404);

  const deleteTable = await owner.post(`/tables/${otherTable.id}/delete`);
  assert.equal(deleteTable.status, 302);

  const { RestaurantTable, Item } = require('../src/models');
  assert.ok(await RestaurantTable.findByPk(otherTable.id));
  assert.equal((await Item.findByPk(otherItem.id)).sold_out, false);
});

test('owner cannot open another restaurant counter', async () => {
  const response = await owner.get(`/counter-admin/${otherRestaurant.slug}/counter`);
  assert.equal(response.status, 404);
});

</code>
